```
1→#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2→set -euo pipefail
     3→
     4→# Streamlined holistic-review pipeline using Codex subagents.
     5→# Usage:
     6→#   scripts/desloppify_holistic_subagents.sh [repo_root]
     7→#
     8→# Optional env vars:
     9→#   SCAN_PATH=src/            # path for final scan (default: src/)
    10→#   RUN_SCAN=1                # run scan after import (default: 1)
    11→#   DESLOPPIFY_PREP_ARGS=""   # extra args for `desloppify review --prepare`
    12→
    13→ROOT="${1:-.}"
    14→ROOT_ABS="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    15→SCAN_PATH="${SCAN_PATH:-src/}"
    16→RUN_SCAN="${RUN_SCAN:-1}"
    17→PREP_ARGS="${DESLOPPIFY_PREP_ARGS:-}"
    18→
    19→QUERY="$ROOT_ABS/.desloppify/query.json"
    20→SUBAGENT_DIR="$ROOT_ABS/.desloppify/subagents"
    21→PROMPTS_DIR="$SUBAGENT_DIR/prompts"
    22→RESULTS_DIR="$SUBAGENT_DIR/results"
    23→LOGS_DIR="$SUBAGENT_DIR/logs"
    24→MERGED_JSON="$SUBAGENT_DIR/holistic_findings_subagents.json"
    25→
    26→require_cmd() {
    27→  command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
    28→    echo "Missing required command: $1" >&2
    29→    exit 1
    30→  }
    31→}
    32→
    33→require_cmd jq
    34→require_cmd codex
    35→require_cmd desloppify
    36→
    37→mkdir -p "$PROMPTS_DIR" "$RESULTS_DIR" "$LOGS_DIR"
    38→rm -f "$PROMPTS_DIR"/batch-*.md "$RESULTS_DIR"/batch-*.raw.txt "$RESULTS_DIR"/batch-*.json "$LOGS_DIR"/batch-*.log
    39→
    40→echo "[1/6] Preparing holistic review packet..."
    41→(
    42→  cd "$ROOT_ABS"
    43→  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
    44→  desloppify review --prepare --holistic --refresh $PREP_ARGS >/dev/null
    45→)
    46→
    47→batch_count="$(jq '.investigation_batches | length' "$QUERY")"
    48→if [[ "$batch_count" -le 0 ]]; then
    49→  echo "No investigation batches found in $QUERY" >&2
    50→  exit 1
    51→fi
    52→
    53→echo "[2/6] Building $batch_count batch prompts..."
    54→for ((i=0; i<batch_count; i++)); do
    55→  n=$((i + 1))
    56→  name="$(jq -r ".investigation_batches[$i].name" "$QUERY")"
    57→  dims="$(jq -r ".investigation_batches[$i].dimensions | join(\",\")" "$QUERY")"
    58→  why="$(jq -r ".investigation_batches[$i].why" "$QUERY")"
    59→  files="$(jq -r ".investigation_batches[$i].files_to_read[]" "$QUERY" | sed 's/^/- /')"
    60→
    61→  cat > "$PROMPTS_DIR/batch-${n}.md" <<EOF
    62→You are a focused subagent reviewer for a single holistic batch.
    63→
    64→Repository root: $ROOT_ABS
    65→Input packet: .desloppify/query.json
    66→Batch index: $n
    67→Batch name: $name
    68→Batch dimensions: $dims
    69→Batch rationale: $why
    70→
    71→Files assigned:
    72→$files
    73→
    74→Task requirements:
    75→1. Read .desloppify/query.json and use the holistic review rules in system_prompt.
    76→2. Evaluate ONLY the listed files and ONLY the listed dimensions for this batch.
    77→3. Emit 0-5 high-quality cross-file findings for this batch (empty array allowed).
    78→4. Every finding must include related_files with at least 2 files from this batch.
    79→5. Do not edit repository files.
    80→6. Return ONLY valid JSON with this shape:
    81→{
    82→  "batch": "$name",
    83→  "assessments": {"<dimension>": <0-100>, ...},
    84→  "findings": [ ... ]
    85→}
    86→EOF
    87→done
    88→
    89→echo "[3/6] Running subagents in parallel..."
    90→pids=()
    91→for ((n=1; n<=batch_count; n++)); do
    92→  prompt_text="$(cat "$PROMPTS_DIR/batch-${n}.md"; printf '\n\nReturn ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences.\n')"
    93→  codex -a never -s workspace-write exec --ephemeral \
    94→    -C "$ROOT_ABS" \
    95→    -o "$RESULTS_DIR/batch-${n}.raw.txt" \
    96→    "$prompt_text" >"$LOGS_DIR/batch-${n}.log" 2>&1 &
    97→  pids+=("$!")
    98→done
    99→
   100→for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do
   101→  wait "$pid"
   102→done
   103→
   104→echo "[4/6] Validating subagent JSON outputs..."
   105→for ((n=1; n<=batch_count; n++)); do
   106→  jq -e . "$RESULTS_DIR/batch-${n}.raw.txt" > "$RESULTS_DIR/batch-${n}.json"
   107→done
   108→
   109→echo "[5/6] Merging outputs..."
   110→jq -s '
   111→  {
   112→    assessments: (
   113→      [ .[] | (.assessments // {}) | to_entries[] ]
   114→      | group_by(.key)
   115→      | map({
   116→          key: .[0].key,
   117→          value: ((map(.value) | add) / (length) | (.*10 | round / 10))
   118→        })
   119→      | from_entries
   120→    ),
   121→    findings: (
   122→      [ .[] | (.findings // [])[] ]
   123→      | unique_by((.dimension // "") + "::" + (.identifier // ""))
   124→    )
   125→  }
   126→' "$RESULTS_DIR"/batch-*.json > "$MERGED_JSON"
   127→
   128→echo "[6/6] Importing merged findings..."
   129→(
   130→  cd "$ROOT_ABS"
   131→  desloppify review --import ".desloppify/subagents/holistic_findings_subagents.json" --holistic
   132→)
   133→
   134→if [[ "$RUN_SCAN" == "1" ]]; then
   135→  echo "[7/7] Running scan on $SCAN_PATH..."
   136→  (
   137→    cd "$ROOT_ABS"
   138→    desloppify scan --path "$SCAN_PATH"
   139→  )
   140→fi
   141→
   142→echo "Done."
   143→echo "Merged findings: $MERGED_JSON"
   144→
```

```
usage: desloppify [-h] [--lang LANG] [--exclude PATTERN]
                  {scan,status,tree,show,next,resolve,ignore,fix,plan,viz,detect,move,review,issues,zone,config,dev} ...

Desloppify — codebase health tracker

positional arguments:
  {scan,status,tree,show,next,resolve,ignore,fix,plan,viz,detect,move,review,issues,zone,config,dev}
    scan                Run all detectors, update state, show diff
    status              Score dashboard with per-tier progress
    tree                Annotated codebase tree (text)
    show                Dig into findings by file, directory, detector, or ID
    next                Show next highest-priority open finding
    resolve             Mark finding(s) as fixed/wontfix/false_positive
    ignore              Add pattern to ignore list, remove matching findings
    fix                 Auto-fix mechanical issues
    plan                Generate prioritized markdown plan from state
    viz                 Generate interactive HTML treemap
    detect              Run a single detector directly (bypass state)
    move                Move a file or directory and update all import
                        references
    review              Prepare or import holistic subjective review
    issues              Review findings work queue
    zone                Show/set/clear zone classifications
    config              Show/set/unset project configuration
    dev                 Developer utilities

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --lang LANG           Language to scan (csharp, python, typescript). Auto-
                        detected if omitted.
  --exclude PATTERN     Path substring to exclude (repeatable: --exclude foo
                        --exclude bar)

workflow:
  scan                          Run all detectors, update state, show diff
  status                        Score dashboard with per-tier progress
  tree                          Annotated codebase tree (zoom with --focus)
  show <pattern>                Dig into findings by file/dir/detector/ID
  resolve <pattern> <status>    Mark findings as fixed/wontfix/false_positive
  ignore <pattern>              Suppress findings matching a pattern
  zone show                     Show zone classifications for all files
  zone set <file> <zone>        Override zone for a file
  review --prepare              Prepare holistic codebase review data
  review --import FILE          Import review findings from JSON
  issues                        Review findings work queue
  plan                          Generate prioritized markdown plan

examples:
  desloppify scan --skip-slow
  desloppify --lang python scan --path scripts/desloppify
  desloppify tree --focus shared/components --sort findings --depth 3
  desloppify tree --detail --focus shared/components/MediaLightbox --min-loc 300
  desloppify show src/shared/components/PromptEditorModal.tsx
  desloppify show gods
  desloppify show "src/shared/components/MediaLightbox"
  desloppify resolve fixed "unused::src/foo.tsx::React" --note "removed symbol" --attest "I have actually fixed improved how [WHAT YOU IMPROVED EXPLICITELY] enough to honestly justify a score of [SCORE] and I am not gaming the score."
  desloppify resolve fixed "logs::src/foo.tsx::*" --note "removed debug logs" --attest "I have actually fixed improved how [WHAT YOU IMPROVED EXPLICITELY] enough to honestly justify a score of [SCORE] and I am not gaming the score."
  desloppify resolve wontfix deprecated --note "migration in progress" --attest "I have actually fixed improved how [WHAT YOU IMPROVED EXPLICITELY] enough to honestly justify a score of [SCORE] and I am not gaming the score."
  desloppify ignore "smells::*::async_no_await" --attest "I have actually fixed improved how [WHAT YOU IMPROVED EXPLICITELY] enough to honestly justify a score of [SCORE] and I am not gaming the score."
  desloppify detect logs --top 10
```

```
  --format {terminal,json,md}
                        Output format (default: terminal)
  --explain             Show ranking and tier-fallback rationale
  --no-tier-fallback    Do not auto-fallback to another tier when --tier has

  --output FILE         Write JSON to file instead of terminal
```

## Summary: Desloppify Configuration and "next" Command

Based on my exploration of the project, here's how to run "desloppify next" and what it does:

### Command to Run

```bash
./.venv-desloppify/bin/desloppify next [OPTIONS]
```

Or if you have the virtual environment activated:
```bash
desloppify next [OPTIONS]
```

### What It Does

`desloppify next` shows the **next highest-priority open code quality findings** to address. It:
1. Reads from the `.desloppify/state-typescript.json` state file (current code quality scan results)
2. Ranks findings by **tier** (1-4, where 1 is most critical) and **confidence**
3. Shows items in priority order with code context
4. Provides auto-fix suggestions where applicable
5. Displays current codebase quality scores and what's impacting them

### Key Configuration Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `.desloppify/plan.json` | Prioritized work queue with clusters and override notes (1.7MB) |
| `.desloppify/query.json` | Query results from last scan - lists all 1912+ findings |
| `.desloppify/state-typescript.json` | Current code quality state with per-finding metadata and scores |
| `.venv-desloppify/bin/desloppify` | Python entry point to the desloppify CLI tool |

### Common Options for `desloppify next`

```bash
desloppify next                          # Show 1 highest-priority item
desloppify next --count 5                # Show top 5 items
desloppify next --tier 2                 # Show tier-2 (critical) items only
desloppify next --explain                # Include ranking rationale
desloppify next --scope src/shared       # Filter to specific path
desloppify next --format json            # Output as JSON
desloppify next --status open            # Filter by status (open/fixed/wontfix/all)
```

### Example Output

Running `desloppify next --count 5 --explain` shows items like:

```
[1/5] (Tier 2, high confidence)
Dead export: toGenerationMetadata
File: src/domains/generation/types/generationMetadata.ts
Auto-fixable: 208 similar findings. Run `desloppify fix dead-exports --dry-run` to fix all at once.
```

### Related Scripts

**Holistic Review Pipeline** (`scripts/desloppify_holistic_subagents.sh`):
- Prepares holistic review packet
- Runs subagent reviewers in parallel
- Merges findings and imports them
- Updates quality scores

Usage: `scripts/desloppify_holistic_subagents.sh [repo_root]`

### Current Project State

- **Overall Score**: 97.0/100 (strict: 97.0/100)
- **Open Findings**: 1,912 (across 4 tiers)
  - Tier 1: 0
  - Tier 2: 224
  - Tier 3: 626
  - Tier 4: 1,062
- **Biggest Issues**:
  - Dead exports (208 findings) - auto-fixable
  - Test coverage gaps (271 findings)
  - Subjective review stale/missing (1,061 findings)

### Key Workflow

1. **Scan**: `desloppify scan --path src` - regenerates findings
2. **View queue**: `desloppify next --count 20` - see top 20 items
3. **Auto-fix**: `desloppify fix dead-exports --dry-run` - preview fixes
4. **Mark resolved**: `desloppify resolve fixed "<finding-id>" --note "description"` - close findings
5. **Refresh subjective**: `desloppify review --prepare --holistic --refresh` - update quality review

```
   122→function useTrimPlaybackGuard({ trimVideoRef, trimState, isVideoTrimMode }: UseTrimPlaybackGuardInput): void {
   123→  useEffect(() => {
   124→    const video = trimVideoRef.current;
   125→    if (!video || !isVideoTrimMode) {

   127→    }
   128→

   130→    const keepEnd = trimState.videoDuration - trimState.endTrim;
   131→    if (video.currentTime < keepStart || video.currentTime >= keepEnd) {
   132→      video.currentTime = keepStart;
   133→    }
   134→
   135→    if (video.paused) {
   136→      video.play().catch(() => {});
   137→    }
   138→  }, [isVideoTrimMode, trimState.startTrim, trimState.endTrim, trimState.videoDuration, trimVideoRef]);
```

```
    11→// Default timeouts for video (longer than images)

    15→interface VideoUploadOptions {

    28→
    29→function resolveVideoUploadOptions(

    32→): ResolvedVideoUploadOptions {

    45→    signal: undefined,

    50→export interface VideoMetadata {

    59→/**

    62→export const extractVideoMetadata = (file: File): Promise<VideoMetadata> => {
    63→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    64→    const video = document.createElement('video');
    65→    video.preload = 'metadata';
    66→    
    67→    video.onloadedmetadata = () => {
    68→      const duration = video.duration;
    69→      const width = video.videoWidth;
    70→      const height = video.videoHeight;
    71→      
    72→      // Estimate frame rate (assume 30fps as standard, could be improved)

    74→      const totalFrames = Math.floor(duration * frameRate);
    75→      
    76→      URL.revokeObjectURL(video.src);
    77→      
    78→      resolve({
    79→        duration_seconds: duration,
    80→        frame_rate: frameRate,

    83→        height,

    91→    };
    92→    
    93→    video.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    94→  });

   134→/**

   142→export async function uploadVideoToStorage(
   143→  file: File,

   145→  onProgress?: (progress: number) => void,
   146→): Promise<string> {

   159→  // Get session for auth and user ID (initial check)
   160→  const { data: initialSessionData } = await supabase().auth.getSession();

   162→    throw new Error('No active session');

   176→    // Check abort before each attempt

   181→    // Refresh session token before each attempt (tokens can expire during retries)
   182→    const { data: sessionData } = await supabase().auth.getSession();
   183→    const accessToken = sessionData?.session?.access_token;
   184→    if (!accessToken) {
   185→      throw new Error('Session expired - please sign in again');
   186→    }
   187→
   188→    try {
   189→
   190→      const bucketUrl = `${getSupabaseUrl()}/storage/v1/object/${MEDIA_BUCKET}/${fileName}`;
   191→
   192→      // Upload with XMLHttpRequest to track progress, with timeout and stall detection
   193→      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
   194→        const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
   195→        let lastProgressTime = Date.now();
   196→        let stallCheckInterval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
   197→        let overallTimeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

   211→        // Stall detection - check every 10 seconds if we've had progress
   212→        stallCheckInterval = setInterval(() => {

   214→          if (timeSinceLastProgress > STALL_TIMEOUT_MS) {

   221→        // Handle abort signal
   222→        const abortHandler = () => {
   223→          cleanup();
   224→          xhr.abort();
   225→          reject(new Error('Upload cancelled'));
   226→        };
   227→        signal?.addEventListener('abort', abortHandler);
   228→
   229→        // Track upload progress
   230→        xhr.upload.addEventListener('progress', (e) => {
   231→          lastProgressTime = Date.now();
   232→          if (e.lengthComputable) {
   233→            const percentComplete = Math.round((e.loaded / e.total) * 100);
   234→            progressCallback?.(percentComplete);
   235→          }
   236→        });
   237→
   238→        xhr.addEventListener('load', () => {
   239→          cleanup();
   240→          signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abortHandler);
   241→          if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
   242→            progressCallback?.(100);
   243→            resolve();
   244→          } else {
   245→            reject(new Error(`Upload failed with status ${xhr.status}: ${xhr.responseText}`));
   246→          }
   247→        });
   248→
   249→        xhr.addEventListener('error', () => {
   250→          cleanup();
   251→          signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abortHandler);
   252→          reject(new Error('Network error during upload'));
   253→        });
   254→
   255→        xhr.addEventListener('abort', () => {
   256→          cleanup();
   257→          signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abortHandler);
   258→          // Reject if not already rejected by timeout/stall/signal handlers
   259→          reject(new Error('Upload aborted'));
   260→        });
   261→
   262→        xhr.open('POST', bucketUrl);
   263→        xhr.setRequestHeader('Authorization', `Bearer ${accessToken}`);
   264→        xhr.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', file.type || 'video/mp4');
   265→        xhr.setRequestHeader('Cache-Control', '3600');

   270→      // Get public URL

   277→    } catch (error) {
   278→      lastError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error('Unknown upload error');
   279→      normalizeAndPresentError(lastError, { context: 'VideoUploader', showToast: false });
   280→
   281→      // Don't retry for user cancellation
   282→      if (lastError.message.includes('cancelled')) {
   283→        throw lastError;
   284→      }
   285→
   286→      if (attempt < maxRetries - 1) {
   287→        // Wait before retrying (exponential backoff)
   288→        const delay = Math.pow(2, attempt) * 1000;
   289→        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
   290→      }
   291→    }
   292→  }
   293→
   294→  // Provide more specific error messages
   295→  if (lastError?.message.includes('cancelled')) {
   296→    throw new Error('Upload cancelled');
   297→  } else if (lastError?.message.includes('timed out') || lastError?.message.includes('stalled')) {
   298→    throw new Error(`Video upload failed: ${file.name} (${fileSizeMB}MB) - connection too slow or unstable. Please check your connection and try again.`);
   299→  } else {
   300→    throw lastError || new Error('Failed to upload video after multiple attempts');
   301→  }
   302→}
```

## Summary

**FINE AS-IS (5 files):**
- `GenerationsPane.tsx` — Dumb render component
- `useLightboxVideoMode.ts` — Intentional facade hook
- `AddNewPresetTab.tsx` — Sectioned form component
- `useTaskStatusCounts.ts` — Cohesive query logic
- `useTimelineViewportController.ts` — Well-scoped viewport logic

**NEEDS DECOMPOSITION (4 files):**
1. **useGenerationsPaneController.ts** (281 LOC) — **Critical:** Split 5 concerns into 4 focused hooks + thin orchestrator
2. **videoUploader.ts** (302 LOC) — **Moderate:** Separate metadata extraction from upload orchestration
3. **taskDataService.ts** (192 LOC) — **High:** Extract massive `extractSettings` function into sub-functions per concern
4. **useShotImagesEditorCallbacks.ts** (293 LOC) — **Moderate-High:** Hoist inner `useDeleteSegmentHandler`, create operation composition hook

The key insight: **lines alone don't determine decomposition.** `useLightboxVideoMode` at 292 LOC is cleaner than `useGenerationsPaneController` at 281 LOC because the former is a facade over distinct subsystems, while the latter conflates multiple responsibilities. Likewise, `useTimelineViewportController` at 221 LOC is justified because all logic serves one goal (viewport control); `taskDataService.ts` at 192 needs splitting because its logic spans orthogonal concerns (DB fetch vs. data transformation).

```
    38→function resolveEffectiveAspectRatio(
    39→  projectAspectRatio: string,
    40→  positionedImages: Array<{ metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null }>,
    41→): string {
    42→  if (positionedImages.length === 0) {
    43→    return projectAspectRatio;
    44→  }
    45→
    46→  const firstImage = positionedImages[0];
    47→  const metadata = firstImage.metadata || {};
    48→  const width = typeof metadata.width === 'number' ? metadata.width : null;
    49→  const height = typeof metadata.height === 'number' ? metadata.height : null;
    50→  if (!width || !height) {
    51→    return projectAspectRatio;
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  return findClosestAspectRatio(width / height);
    55→}

    77→export function useVideoGenerationModalController({ isOpen, onClose, shot }: VideoGenerationModalProps) {
    78→  const { selectedProjectId, projects } = useProject();

   131→      .sort((first, second) => (first.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (second.timeline_frame ?? 0));
   132→  }, [shotGenerations]);
   133→
   134→  const currentProject = projects.find((project) => project.id === selectedProjectId);
   135→  const projectAspectRatio = currentProject?.aspectRatio || '16:9';
   136→
   137→  const effectiveAspectRatio = useMemo(

   142→  const selectedLoras = useMemo(

   147→  const validPresetId = useMemo(() => {

   154→
   155→  const handleAddLora = useCallback(

   269→          default_negative_prompt: mergedSteerableSettings.negative_prompt,
   270→        },
   271→        motionConfig: {

   273→          motion_mode: motionMode,
   274→          advanced_mode: advancedMode,
```

### T3 Cycle: VideoGenerationModal ↔ useVideoGenerationModalController

**Import Chain:**
1. `VideoGenerationModal.tsx` (line 13) imports from `./hooks/useVideoGenerationModalController`
2. `useVideoGenerationModalController.ts` (line 28) imports from `../VideoGenerationModal`:

   ```typescript
   import type { VideoGenerationModalProps } from '../VideoGenerationModal';
   ```

**Assessment:** 
- This is a **type-only import** (using `import type`)
- TypeScript erases `import type` statements at runtime, so this creates no actual circular dependency at runtime
- However, the cycle still exists at the type-checking level and desloppify flags it

**Fix:**
Extract `VideoGenerationModalProps` to a separate types file:
- Create: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/tools/travel-between-images/components/VideoGenerationModal.types.ts`
- Move the interface there
- Both files import from the types file

---

### T4 Cycle: PromptGenerationControls → AdvancedOptionsPanel → TemperatureSelector → useGenerationControlsState

**Import Chain:**
1. `PromptGenerationControls.tsx` (line 9) imports from `./PromptGenerationControls/hooks/useGenerationControlsState`
2. `PromptGenerationControls.tsx` (line 10) imports from `./PromptGenerationControls/components/AdvancedOptionsPanel`
3. `AdvancedOptionsPanel.tsx` (line 5) imports from `./TemperatureSelector`
4. `TemperatureSelector.tsx` (line 3) imports from `@/shared/components/PromptGenerationControls`:
   ```typescript
   import { temperatureOptions } from '@/shared/components/PromptGenerationControls';
   ```
5. `useGenerationControlsState.ts` (line 2) also imports from `@/shared/components/PromptGenerationControls`:
   ```typescript
   import { temperatureOptions, type GenerationControlValues } from '@/shared/components/PromptGenerationControls';
   ```

**The Cycle:** `PromptGenerationControls.tsx` → `AdvancedOptionsPanel` → `TemperatureSelector` → back to `PromptGenerationControls.tsx` (via the `temperatureOptions` export)

**Assessment:**
- Both `TemperatureSelector` and `useGenerationControlsState` import from the parent `PromptGenerationControls` component
- `TemperatureSelector` imports `temperatureOptions` (line 3)
- `useGenerationControlsState` imports `temperatureOptions` and `GenerationControlValues` (line 2)
- Since `PromptGenerationControls` imports both of those child files, this creates a cycle
- The imports from child to parent are **a mix**: `temperatureOptions` is a runtime value, while `GenerationControlValues` could be type-only (marked with `type`)

**Fix:**
Extract shared constants and types to a separate file:
- Create: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/PromptGenerationControls/types.ts`
- Move `TemperatureOption` interface and `temperatureOptions` array there
- Move `GenerationControlValues` interface there
- Update all files to import from this types file instead of the parent component

---

## Summary

| Cycle | Issue | Fix |
|-------|-------|-----|
| **T3** | `VideoGenerationModalProps` imported as type in the hook file, creating a circular dependency | Extract to `VideoGenerationModal.types.ts` |
| **T4** | `temperatureOptions` (runtime value) and `GenerationControlValues` (type) exported from parent, imported by children that are themselves imported by parent | Extract to `PromptGenerationControls/types.ts` |

Both fixes follow the same pattern: **move shared types/constants to a dedicated types file** that sits outside the main import hierarchy. This breaks the cycles while keeping the data accessible to all consumers.

```
1→interface TriggerBrowserDownloadOptions {
     2→  target?: '_self' | '_blank';
     3→}
     4→
     5→export function triggerBrowserDownload(
     6→  url: string,
     7→  filename: string,
     8→  options: TriggerBrowserDownloadOptions = {},
     9→): void {
    10→  const link = document.createElement('a');
    11→  link.href = url;
    12→  link.download = filename;
    13→  if (options.target) {
    14→    link.target = options.target;
    15→  }
    16→
    17→  document.body.appendChild(link);
    18→  link.click();
    19→  document.body.removeChild(link);
    20→}
    21→
    22→export function downloadBlobAsFile(blob: Blob, filename: string): void {
    23→  const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    24→  try {
    25→    triggerBrowserDownload(objectUrl, filename);
    26→  } finally {
    27→    setTimeout(() => {
    28→      URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
    29→    }, 1000);
    30→  }
    31→}
    32→
```

```
     9→const noop = () => {};
    10→
    11→interface FinalVideoSectionDisplayProps {
    12→  projectAspectRatio?: string;
    13→  shouldShowSkeleton: boolean;
    14→  hasFinalOutput: boolean;
    15→  parentVideoRow: GenerationRow | null;
    16→  isMobile: boolean;
    17→  projectId: string;
    18→  onLightboxOpen: () => void;
    19→  onMobileTap: () => void;

    21→  readOnly: boolean;

    25→  isCurrentlyLoading: boolean;
    26→  hasActiveJoinTask: boolean;
    27→}
    28→
    29→function getFinalVideoWidthStyle(projectAspectRatio?: string): React.CSSProperties {
    30→  if (!projectAspectRatio) {
    31→    return { width: '50%' };
    32→  }
    33→
    34→  const [width, height] = projectAspectRatio.split(':').map(Number);
    35→  if (!width || !height) {
    36→    return { width: '50%' };
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  const ratio = width / height;
    40→  if (height > width) {
    41→    return { width: `min(100%, calc(60vh * ${ratio}))` };
    42→  }
    43→
    44→  return { width: '50%' };
    45→}
    46→
    47→export const FinalVideoSectionDisplay: React.FC<FinalVideoSectionDisplayProps> = ({
    48→  projectAspectRatio,
    49→  shouldShowSkeleton,
    50→  hasFinalOutput,
    51→  parentVideoRow,
    52→  isMobile,
    53→  projectId,
    54→  onLightboxOpen,

    59→  onDeleteSelected,

    61→  isCurrentlyLoading,
    62→  hasActiveJoinTask,
    63→}) => {
    64→  if (shouldShowSkeleton) {
    65→    return (
    66→      <div className="flex justify-center mt-4">
    67→        <div style={getFinalVideoWidthStyle(projectAspectRatio)}>
    68→          <Skeleton
    69→            className="w-full rounded-lg"
    70→            style={{
    71→              aspectRatio: projectAspectRatio ? projectAspectRatio.replace(':', '/') : '16/9',
    72→            }}
    73→          />
    74→        </div>
    75→      </div>
    76→    );
    77→  }
    78→
    79→  if (hasFinalOutput && parentVideoRow) {
    80→    return (
    81→      <div className="flex justify-center mt-4">
    82→        <div className="relative group" style={getFinalVideoWidthStyle(projectAspectRatio)}>
    83→          <VideoItem
    84→            video={parentVideoRow}
    85→            index={0}
    86→            originalIndex={0}
    87→            shouldPreload="metadata"
    88→            isMobile={isMobile}
    89→            projectAspectRatio={projectAspectRatio}
    90→            projectId={projectId}
    91→            onLightboxOpen={() => onLightboxOpen()}
    92→            onMobileTap={() => onMobileTap()}
    93→            onDelete={noop}
    94→            deletingVideoId={null}
    95→            onHoverStart={noop}
    96→            onHoverEnd={noop}
    97→            onMobileModalOpen={noop}
    98→            selectedVideoForDetails={null}
    99→            showTaskDetailsModal={false}
   100→            onApplySettingsFromTask={onApplySettingsFromTask || noop}
   101→            hideActions
   102→          />
   103→
   104→          {!readOnly && onDelete && (
   105→            <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">

   108→                  <Button
   109→                    variant="destructive"

   112→                    onClick={(event) => {
   113→                      event.stopPropagation();
   114→                      onDeleteSelected();
   115→                    }}
   116→                    disabled={isDeleting}
   117→                  >
   118→                    {isDeleting ? (
   119→                      <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
   120→                    ) : (
   121→                      <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
   122→                    )}
   123→                  </Button>
   124→                </TooltipTrigger>
   125→                <TooltipContent>Delete final video</TooltipContent>
   126→              </Tooltip>
   127→            </div>
   128→          )}
   129→        </div>
   130→      </div>
   131→    );
   132→  }
   133→
   134→  return (
   135→    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center pt-4 pb-1 text-muted-foreground">
   136→      {isCurrentlyLoading ? (
   137→        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
   138→          <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
   139→          <span className="text-sm">Loading...</span>
   140→        </div>
   141→      ) : hasActiveJoinTask ? (
   142→        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
   143→          <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
   144→          <span className="text-sm">Generating joined clip...</span>
   145→        </div>
   146→      ) : (
   147→        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
   148→          <Film className="w-4 h-4 opacity-40" />
   149→          <span className="text-sm">No final video yet</span>
   150→        </div>
   151→      )}
   152→    </div>
   153→  );
   154→};
```

```
    50→  if (!width || !height) {
    51→    return projectAspectRatio;
    52→  }
    53→
```

```
    89→async function waitForVariantDelay(
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically
     8→ * get the new field.
     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:
    11→ * - DRY: No duplicated transformation logic across hooks/components
    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation
    15→ * 
    16→ * NOTE: upscaled_url has been removed - upscaled versions are now stored as
    17→ * generation_variants with variant_type='upscaled' and become the primary variant,
    18→ * so `location` already contains the best available URL.

    33→/**
    34→ * Result type for calculateDerivedCounts
    35→ */
    36→export interface DerivedCountsResult {
    37→  /** Count of variants/derivatives per generation */
    38→  derivedCounts: Record<string, number>;
    39→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    40→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    41→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */
    42→  unviewedVariantCounts: Record<string, number>;
    43→  /** True when counts were intentionally returned empty due to a read-path failure. */
    44→  degraded?: boolean;
    45→  /** Machine-readable reason for degraded fallback behavior. */
    46→  errorCode?: 'query_failed';
    47→}
    48→
    49→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    50→  return {
    51→    derivedCounts: {},
    52→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    53→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},
    54→  };
    55→}
    56→
    57→/**
    58→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    59→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    60→ *
    61→ * Queries both:
    62→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    63→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    64→ *
    65→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    66→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    67→ */
    68→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    69→  generationIds: string[]
    70→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    71→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    72→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    73→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    77→
    78→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    79→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    80→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    81→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    82→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    83→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    84→
    85→  if (variantCountsError) {
    86→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    87→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    88→      cause: variantCountsError,
    89→    });
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  if (variantCountsData) {
    93→    for (const item of variantCountsData as Array<{ generation_id: string; viewed_at: string | null }>) {
    94→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    95→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    96→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    97→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    98→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    99→      }
   100→    }
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   104→}

   203→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {

   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {

   310→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access

   336→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data

   341→      return {

   360→      if (matchingShot) {
   361→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   362→      }
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    return {
   366→      ...baseItem,
   367→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   368→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   369→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   370→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   371→    };
   372→  }
   373→  
   374→  return baseItem;
   375→}
   376→
   377→/**
   378→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   379→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   380→ */
   381→export function transformForTimeline(
   382→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   383→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   384→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   385→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   386→  
   387→  if (!genData) {
   388→    return {
   389→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   390→      id: shotGen.id,
   391→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   392→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   393→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   394→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   395→    };
   396→  }
   397→  
   398→  return {
   399→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   400→    id: shotGen.id,
   401→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   402→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   403→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   404→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   405→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   406→    location: genData.location,
   407→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   408→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   409→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   410→    metadata: (shotGen.metadata as GenerationMetadata | undefined) ?? undefined,
   411→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   412→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   413→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   414→  };
   415→}
   416→
   417→/**
   418→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   419→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   420→ */
   421→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   422→  if (!url) return false;
   423→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   424→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   425→}
   426→
   427→/**
   428→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   429→ *
   430→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   431→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   432→ *
   433→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   434→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   435→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   436→ */
   437→export function transformVariant(
   438→  variant: RawVariant,
   439→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   440→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   441→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   442→  const variantParams = (variant.params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   443→  const storedContentType = variantParams.content_type as string | undefined;
   444→
   445→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   446→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   447→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   448→  } else {
   449→    contentType = 'image/png';
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  return {
   453→    id: variant.id,
   454→    url: variant.location,
   455→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   456→    isVideo,
   457→    contentType,
   458→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   459→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   460→    metadata: {
   461→      prompt: variantParams.prompt as string | undefined,
   462→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   463→      name: variant.name,
   464→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   465→      tool_type: (variantParams.tool_type as string) || options?.toolType,
   466→      created_from: variantParams.created_from as string | undefined,
   467→      source_task_id: variantParams.source_task_id as string | undefined,
   468→      content_type: storedContentType,
   469→    },
   470→    shot_id: undefined,
   471→    position: undefined,
   472→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   473→  };
   474→}
   475→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Best-effort clipboard write that never throws.
     3→ * Returns true when the write succeeds.
     4→ */
     5→export async function writeClipboardTextSafe(
     6→  text: string,
     7→  options: { allowExecCommandFallback?: boolean } = {},
     8→): Promise<boolean> {
     9→  if (!text) {
    10→    return false;
    11→  }
    12→
    13→  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    14→    try {
    15→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    16→      return true;
    17→    } catch {
    18→      // fall through to optional fallback
    19→    }
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  if (!options.allowExecCommandFallback || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  let textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement | null = null;
    27→  try {
    28→    textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    29→    textarea.value = text;
    30→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    31→    textarea.style.left = '-9999px';
    32→    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    33→    textarea.select();
    34→    return document.execCommand('copy') === true;
    35→  } catch {
    36→    return false;
    37→  } finally {
    38→    if (textarea?.parentNode) {
    39→      textarea.parentNode.removeChild(textarea);
    40→    }
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→
```

- **Is it dead?** NO - actively used in 14 files
- **Usage**: 
  - `useTaskItemDisplay.ts` calls `useTaskTimestamp()` which calls `useRelativeTimestamp()` 
  - `UpdatingTimeCell.tsx` directly uses `useUpdatingTimestamp()`
  - Has tests in `useUpdatingTimestamp.test.ts`
- **Fix**: **WONTFIX** - This is an intentional public alias. Users can call either `useUpdatingTimestamp()` or `useRelativeTimestamp()` directly. The wrapper is thin but provides a better DX for the most common case.

**2. `triggerBrowserDownload()` @ src/shared/runtime/browserDownloadRuntime.ts:5**
- **What it does**: Creates a temporary `<a>` element, sets href/download attributes, clicks it, then removes it—the standard browser download trigger.
- **Is it dead?** NO - actively used
- **Usage**: Called in `downloadMedia.ts:127` as a fallback when fetch+blob fails
- **Fix**: **WONTFIX** - Real function doing real work. It's a fallback, not primary path, but absolutely needed for robust download handling.

**3. `noop = () => {}` @ src/tools/travel-between-images/components/FinalVideoSectionDisplay.tsx:9**
- **What it does**: No-op callback passed to `VideoItem` for disabled actions (onDelete, onHoverStart, onHoverEnd, onMobileModalOpen).
- **Is it dead?** NO - actively used
- **Usage**: Lines 93, 95, 96, 97 - passed to VideoItem when actions should be disabled
- **Context**: Component has `hideActions` prop and readonly checks; noop prevents undefined callback errors
- **Fix**: **DELETE** - Instead of passing `noop`, just make VideoItem callbacks optional (add `?:` to their types). Then pass `undefined` or nothing. This is cleaner than defining a dummy function.

**4. `clearAllEnhancedPrompts = async () => {}` @ src/tools/travel-between-images/components/hooks/useVideoGenerationModalController.ts:36**
- **What it does**: Empty async stub
- **Is it dead?** NO - it's called, but it's a NOP stub
- **Usage**: 
  - Line 271 in `generateVideoService.ts`: `await clearAllEnhancedPrompts()` (only when `!promptConfig.enhance_prompt`)
  - Line 168 in `useGenerationController.ts`: `await clearAllEnhancedPrompts()` 
  - Line 294: passed to `generateVideo()`
- **Context**: Function signature says it should clear enhanced prompts from settings, but the stub does nothing. This looks like incomplete feature implementation.
- **Fix**: **INVESTIGATE** - Either this needs real implementation (look for what "enhanced prompts" storage exists), or it's tech debt from a removed feature. The calls wrapped in try/catch suggest it was intentionally stubbed as "fail-open". Need to understand the intent.

**5. `logInvalidationEvent()` @ src/shared/hooks/invalidation/useGenerationInvalidation.ts:34**
- **What it does**: Empty function with comment "Intentionally empty — call sites kept for easy re-enablement during debugging"
- **Is it dead?** NO - it's intentionally a NOP for performance/debug control
- **Usage**: Called in 10+ places throughout the file for logging invalidation lifecycle
- **Fix**: **WONTFIX** - This is intentional instrumentation pattern. The empty stub lets developers quickly flip on debug logging by uncommenting the implementation without changing callsites.

**6. `addCorruptionEvent()` @ src/integrations/supabase/utils/timeline.ts:6**
- **What it does**: Pushes corruption diagnostic events to a ring buffer ONLY when `__CORRUPTION_TRACE_ENABLED__` flag is true. Otherwise does nothing.
- **Is it dead?** NO - conditionally active, guard-checked
- **Usage**: Called from multiple places; maintains a rolling 100-item timeline for debugging DB corruption
- **Fix**: **WONTFIX** - Intentional instrumentation. Dead code when flag is off, but that's the design.

**7. `transformGeneration()` @ src/shared/lib/generationTransformers.ts:262**
- **What it does**: Main transformation function converting raw DB generation records to UI-ready format. Extracts prompt, thumbnail, handles shot associations, normalizes positions, etc.
- **Is it dead?** NO - NOT A PASSTHROUGH
- **Usage**: Core function used by many hooks and components
- **Fix**: **WONTFIX** - This is a real transformer doing significant work (field extraction, URL normalization, shot data expansion, etc.)

### ASYNC WITHOUT AWAIT (both are intentionally fire-and-forget)

**8. `createDefaultShotForProject()` @ src/shared/services/projects/projectSetupService.ts:30**
- **What it is**: Async function, but when called with `await` in `createDefaultShotWithRollback()` line 83
- **Is this the issue?** NO - it IS awaited properly
- **Could the finding be:** Line 54 in the same file: `await copyTemplateToNewUser()` happens within function, but that's correct too.
- **Fix**: **WONTFIX** - Function signature is async and awaits correctly internally. No issue here.

**9. `writeClipboardTextSafe()` @ src/shared/lib/clipboard.ts:5**
- **What it does**: Async function that tries navigator.clipboard API first, falls back to execCommand
- **Where called**: `useCopyToClipboard.ts:14` - `void writeClipboardTextSafe(text)`
- **Is this the issue?** YES - intentionally fire-and-forget with `void`
- **Context**: The function is marked as returning `Promise<boolean>`, but caller doesn't wait or handle the result because it's best-effort clipboard write
- **Fix**: **WONTFIX** - Intentional pattern. Clipboard writes are non-critical UI sugar; the app doesn't need to block on success/failure. The `void` is explicit about discarding the promise. However, if you want to be stricter: (a) return the promise without void if you want caller accountability, or (b) change signature to return `void` and handle internally.

```
   357→  media: GenerationRow;
   358→  canvasEnvironment: {

   361→    isCloudMode: boolean;

   363→    imageContainerRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement>;

   369→  };
   370→  inpaintingState: {
   371→    isInpaintMode: boolean;
   372→    editMode: InpaintingHookResult['editMode'];
   373→    brushStrokes: InpaintingHookResult['brushStrokes'];
   374→    currentStroke: InpaintingHookResult['currentStroke'];
   375→    isDrawing: boolean;

   377→    brushSize: number;
   378→    annotationMode: InpaintingHookResult['annotationMode'];
   379→    selectedShapeId: string | null;
   380→    isAnnotateMode: boolean;
   381→    handleKonvaPointerDown: InpaintingHookResult['handleKonvaPointerDown'];
   382→    handleKonvaPointerMove: InpaintingHookResult['handleKonvaPointerMove'];
   383→    handleKonvaPointerUp: InpaintingHookResult['handleKonvaPointerUp'];
   384→    handleShapeClick: InpaintingHookResult['handleShapeClick'];
   385→    strokeOverlayRef: InpaintingHookResult['strokeOverlayRef'];
   386→    getDeleteButtonPosition: InpaintingHookResult['getDeleteButtonPosition'];
   387→    handleToggleFreeForm: InpaintingHookResult['handleToggleFreeForm'];
   388→    handleDeleteSelected: InpaintingHookResult['handleDeleteSelected'];
   389→    handleUndo: InpaintingHookResult['handleUndo'];
   390→    handleClearMask: InpaintingHookResult['handleClearMask'];
   391→    setIsInpaintMode: InpaintingHookResult['setIsInpaintMode'];
   392→    setEditMode: InpaintingHookResult['setEditMode'];
   393→    setBrushSize: InpaintingHookResult['setBrushSize'];
   394→    setIsEraseMode: InpaintingHookResult['setIsEraseMode'];
   395→    setAnnotationMode: InpaintingHookResult['setAnnotationMode'];
   396→    isSpecialEditMode: boolean;
   397→    handleEnterMagicEditMode: MagicEditHookResult['handleEnterMagicEditMode'];
   398→  };
   399→  transformState: {
   400→    repositionTransform: RepositionHookResult['transform'];
   401→    setScale: RepositionHookResult['setScale'];
   402→    setRotation: RepositionHookResult['setRotation'];
   403→    toggleFlipH: RepositionHookResult['toggleFlipH'];
   404→    toggleFlipV: RepositionHookResult['toggleFlipV'];
   405→    resetTransform: RepositionHookResult['resetTransform'];
   406→    getTransformStyle: RepositionHookResult['getTransformStyle'];
   407→  };
   408→  generationState: {
   409→    localStarred: StarToggleHookResult['localStarred'];
   410→    toggleStarMutation: StarToggleHookResult['toggleStarMutation'];
   411→    handleToggleStar: StarToggleHookResult['handleToggleStar'];
   412→    handleDownload: () => Promise<void>;
   413→    handleUnifiedGenerate: MagicEditHookResult['handleUnifiedGenerate'];
   414→    handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit: InpaintingHookResult['handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit'];
   415→    handleGenerateReposition: RepositionHookResult['handleGenerateReposition'];
   416→    handleSaveAsVariant: RepositionHookResult['handleSaveAsVariant'];
   417→    handleGenerateImg2Img: Img2ImgHookResult['handleGenerateImg2Img'];
   418→    img2imgLoraManager: Img2ImgHookResult['loraManager'];

   431→}
   432→
   433→export function useInlineEditState(
   434→  media: GenerationRow,
   435→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   436→): InlineEditStateResult {
   437→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   438→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   439→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   440→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   441→
   442→  useEffect(() => {
   443→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   444→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   445→
   446→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   447→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   448→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   449→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   450→
   451→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   452→
   453→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   454→    media,
   455→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   456→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   457→      : undefined,
   458→  });
   459→
   460→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   461→
   462→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   463→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   464→  };
   465→
   466→  const {
   467→    inpaintingState,
   468→    transformState,
   469→    generationState,
   470→    imageEditValue,
   471→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   472→    env,
   473→    persistence,
   474→    inpainting,
   475→    magic,
   476→    reposition,
   477→    img2img,
   478→    starToggle,
   479→    handleDownload,
   480→  });
   481→
   482→  return {
   483→    media,
   484→    canvasEnvironment: {
   485→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   486→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   487→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   488→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   489→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   490→      effectiveImageUrl,
   491→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   492→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   493→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   494→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   495→    },
   496→    inpaintingState,
   497→    transformState,
   498→    generationState,
   499→    variants: {
   500→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   501→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   502→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   503→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   504→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   505→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,
   506→    },
   507→    sourceGenerationData,
   508→    availableLoras,
   509→    imageEditValue,
   510→  } satisfies InlineEditStateResult;
   511→}
```

```
     3→ *
     4→ * Extracted from useReferenceUpload to isolate the delete/update/visibility

     6→ *
     7→ * Handles:

    13→import { useCallback } from 'react';
    14→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

    22→// ============================================================================

    25→
    26→/**
    27→ * Build full StyleReferenceMetadata from a HydratedReferenceImage.
    28→ * Centralises the mapping so new metadata fields only need updating in one place.
    29→ */
    30→function buildResourceMetadata(
    31→  ref: HydratedReferenceImage,
    32→  overrides: Partial<StyleReferenceMetadata> = {},
    33→): StyleReferenceMetadata {
    34→  return {
    35→    name: ref.name,
    36→    styleReferenceImage: ref.styleReferenceImage,
    37→    styleReferenceImageOriginal: ref.styleReferenceImageOriginal,
    38→    thumbnailUrl: ref.thumbnailUrl,
    39→    styleReferenceStrength: ref.styleReferenceStrength,
    40→    subjectStrength: ref.subjectStrength,
    41→    subjectDescription: ref.subjectDescription,
    42→    inThisScene: ref.inThisScene,
    43→    inThisSceneStrength: ref.inThisSceneStrength,
    44→    referenceMode: ref.referenceMode,
    45→    styleBoostTerms: ref.styleBoostTerms,
    46→    created_by: { is_you: true },
    47→    is_public: ref.isPublic,
    48→    createdAt: ref.createdAt,
    49→    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    50→    ...overrides,
    51→  };
    52→}
    53→
    54→// ============================================================================
    55→// Types
    56→// ============================================================================
    57→
    58→interface UseReferenceResourceMutationsProps {
    59→  selectedProjectId: string | undefined;
    60→  referencePointers: ReferenceImage[];
    61→  hydratedReferences: HydratedReferenceImage[];
    62→  selectedReferenceIdByShot: Record<string, string | null>;
    63→  updateProjectImageSettings: (scope: 'project' | 'shot', updates: Partial<ProjectImageSettings>) => Promise<void>;
    64→  markAsInteracted: () => void;
    65→}
    66→
    67→interface UseReferenceResourceMutationsReturn {
    68→  handleDeleteReference: (referenceId: string) => Promise<void>;
    69→  handleUpdateReferenceName: (referenceId: string, name: string) => Promise<void>;
    70→  handleToggleVisibility: (resourceId: string, currentIsPublic: boolean) => Promise<void>;
    71→}
    72→
    73→// ============================================================================
    74→// Hook Implementation
    75→// ============================================================================
    76→
    77→export function useReferenceResourceMutations(
    78→  props: UseReferenceResourceMutationsProps,
    79→): UseReferenceResourceMutationsReturn {
    80→  const {
    81→    selectedProjectId,
    82→    referencePointers,
    83→    hydratedReferences,
    84→    selectedReferenceIdByShot,
    85→    updateProjectImageSettings,
    86→    markAsInteracted,
    87→  } = props;
    88→
    89→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    90→  const updateStyleReference = useUpdateResource();
    91→  const deleteStyleReference = useDeleteResource();
    92→
    93→  // ============================================================================
    94→  // Delete Reference
    95→  // ============================================================================
    96→
    97→  const handleDeleteReference = useCallback(async (referenceId: string) => {
    98→
    99→    const hydratedRef = hydratedReferences.find(r => r.id === referenceId);
   100→    if (!hydratedRef) {
   101→      console.error('[useReferenceResourceMutations] Could not find reference:', referenceId);
   102→      return;
   103→    }
   104→
   105→    // Delete the resource from resources table
   106→    try {
   107→      await deleteStyleReference.mutateAsync({
   108→        id: hydratedRef.resourceId,
   109→        type: 'style-reference',
   110→      });
   111→    } catch (error) {
   112→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useReferenceResourceMutations.handleDeleteReference', toastTitle: 'Failed to delete reference' });
   113→      return;
   114→    }
   115→
   116→    // Remove pointer from settings
   117→    const filteredPointers = referencePointers.filter(ref => ref.id !== referenceId);
   118→
   119→    // Update all shot selections that had this reference selected
   120→    const updatedSelections = { ...selectedReferenceIdByShot };
   121→    Object.keys(updatedSelections).forEach(shotId => {
   122→      if (updatedSelections[shotId] === referenceId) {
   123→        updatedSelections[shotId] = filteredPointers[0]?.id ?? null;
   124→      }
   125→    });
   126→
   127→    // Optimistic UI update
   128→    try {
   129→      queryClient.setQueryData(settingsQueryKeys.tool(SETTINGS_IDS.PROJECT_IMAGE_SETTINGS, selectedProjectId, undefined), (prev: unknown) =>
   130→        updateSettingsCache<ProjectImageSettings>(prev, {
   131→          references: filteredPointers,
   132→          selectedReferenceIdByShot: updatedSelections
   133→        })
   134→      );
   135→    } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
   136→
   137→    await updateProjectImageSettings('project', {
   138→      references: filteredPointers,
   139→      selectedReferenceIdByShot: updatedSelections
   140→    });
   141→
   142→    markAsInteracted();
   143→  }, [hydratedReferences, referencePointers, selectedReferenceIdByShot, deleteStyleReference, updateProjectImageSettings, markAsInteracted, queryClient, selectedProjectId]);
   144→
   145→  // ============================================================================
   146→  // Update Reference Name
   147→  // ============================================================================
   148→
   149→  const handleUpdateReferenceName = useCallback(async (referenceId: string, name: string) => {
   150→
   151→    // Find the hydrated reference to get the resourceId
   152→    const hydratedRef = hydratedReferences.find(r => r.id === referenceId);
   153→    if (!hydratedRef) {
   154→      console.error('[useReferenceResourceMutations] Could not find reference:', referenceId);
   155→      return;
   156→    }
   157→
   158→    // Name is stored on the Resource, not the pointer - update via updateStyleReference
   159→    try {
   160→      const metadata = buildResourceMetadata(hydratedRef, { name });
   161→
   162→      await updateStyleReference.mutateAsync({
   163→        id: hydratedRef.resourceId,
   164→        type: 'style-reference',
   165→        metadata,
   166→      });
   167→
   168→    } catch (error) {
   169→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useReferenceResourceMutations.handleUpdateReferenceName', toastTitle: 'Failed to update name' });
   170→    }
   171→  }, [hydratedReferences, updateStyleReference]);
   172→
   173→  // ============================================================================
   174→  // Toggle Visibility
   175→  // ============================================================================
   176→
   177→  const handleToggleVisibility = useCallback(async (resourceId: string, currentIsPublic: boolean) => {
   178→
   179→    const hydratedRef = hydratedReferences.find(r => r.resourceId === resourceId);
   180→    if (!hydratedRef) {
   181→      console.error('[useReferenceResourceMutations] Could not find reference with resourceId:', resourceId);
   182→      return;
   183→    }
   184→
   185→    try {
   186→      const metadata = buildResourceMetadata(hydratedRef, { is_public: !currentIsPublic });
   187→
   188→      await updateStyleReference.mutateAsync({
   189→        id: resourceId,
   190→        type: 'style-reference',
   191→        metadata,
   192→      });
   193→
   194→    } catch (error) {
   195→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useReferenceResourceMutations.handleToggleVisibility', toastTitle: 'Failed to update visibility' });
   196→    }
   197→  }, [hydratedReferences, updateStyleReference]);
   198→
   199→  return {
   200→    handleDeleteReference,
   201→    handleUpdateReferenceName,
   202→    handleToggleVisibility,
   203→  };
   204→}
```

```
     2→import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     3→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     4→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     5→import { taskQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/tasks';
     6→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     7→import { getProjectSelectionFallbackId } from '@/shared/contexts/projectSelectionStore';
     8→import { isTaskDbRow, mapTaskDbRowToTask } from '@/shared/lib/taskRowMapper';
     9→import {
    10→  getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations,
    11→  toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry,
    12→  type GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry,
    13→  type GenerationTaskMappingStatus,
    14→} from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskRepository';
    15→
    16→interface PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions {
    17→  batchSize?: number;
    18→  delayBetweenBatches?: number;
    19→  preloadFullTaskData?: boolean;
    20→}
    21→
    22→interface GenerationWithTaskData extends GenerationRow {
    23→  taskId?: string | null;
    24→  taskData?: Task | null;
    25→  taskMappingStatus?: GenerationTaskMappingStatus;
    26→  taskMappingError?: string;
    27→}
    28→
    29→function resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId: string | null): string | null {
    30→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    31→    return projectId;
    32→  }
    33→  const selectedProjectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    34→  if (selectedProjectId && selectedProjectId.trim().length > 0) {
    35→    return selectedProjectId;
    36→  }
    37→  return null;
    38→}
    39→
    40→/**
    41→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    42→ */
    43→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    44→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    45→  generationIds: string[],
    46→  projectId: string | null,
    47→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    48→) {
    49→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    50→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
    51→  const {
    52→    batchSize = 5,
    53→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    54→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    55→  } = options;
    56→
    57→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    58→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    59→
    60→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId: effectiveProjectId ?? undefined });
    61→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    62→
    63→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    64→
    65→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    66→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    67→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    68→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    69→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    70→        cacheEntry,
    71→      );
    72→
    73→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    74→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    75→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    76→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    77→          showToast: false,
    78→        });
    79→      }
    80→
    81→      if (preloadFullTaskData && effectiveProjectId && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    82→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    83→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    84→          queryFn: async () => {
    85→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    86→              .from('tasks')
    87→              .select('*')
    88→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    89→              .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId)
    90→              .single();
    91→
    92→            if (error) throw error;
    93→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    94→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    95→            }
    96→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    97→          },
    98→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    99→        }));
   100→      }
   101→    });
   102→
   103→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   104→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   108→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   109→    }
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   114→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   115→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   116→  projectId: string | null,
   117→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   118→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   119→
   120→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   121→    const generationId = generation.generation_id ?? generation.id;
   122→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   123→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   124→    );
   125→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   126→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   127→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   128→      : null;
   129→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   130→
   131→    return {
   132→      ...generation,
   133→      taskId,
   134→      taskData,
   135→      taskMappingStatus,
   136→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   137→    };
   138→  });
   139→}
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Mask generation utilities for image reposition operations.
     3→ * Extracts mask from canvas alpha channel and dilates to eliminate edge artifacts.
     4→ */
     5→
     6→interface MaskGenerationOptions {
     7→  /** Alpha threshold (0-255). Pixels with alpha above this are considered solid. Default: 200 */
     8→  alphaThreshold?: number;
     9→  /** Number of pixels to dilate the mask into the image. Default: 3 */
    10→  dilationPixels?: number;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/**
    14→ * Generates a mask canvas from a transformed image canvas.
    15→ * White areas = regions to inpaint (transparent/edge areas)
    16→ * Black areas = regions to keep (solid image content)
    17→ *
    18→ * The mask is dilated by a few pixels to ensure edge artifacts are included in the inpaint region.
    19→ *
    20→ * @param sourceCanvas - Canvas with transformed image (uses alpha channel for mask detection)
    21→ * @param options - Configuration options for threshold and dilation
    22→ * @returns Canvas containing the generated mask
    23→ */
    24→export function generateMaskFromCanvas(
    25→  sourceCanvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
    26→  options: MaskGenerationOptions = {}
    27→): HTMLCanvasElement {
    28→  const { alphaThreshold = 200, dilationPixels = 3 } = options;
    29→
    30→  const width = sourceCanvas.width;
    31→  const height = sourceCanvas.height;
    32→
    33→  const sourceCtx = sourceCanvas.getContext('2d');
    34→  if (!sourceCtx) {
    35→    throw new Error('Could not get source canvas context');
    36→  }
    37→
    38→  // Create mask canvas
    39→  const maskCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    40→  maskCanvas.width = width;
    41→  maskCanvas.height = height;
    42→  const maskCtx = maskCanvas.getContext('2d');
    43→
    44→  if (!maskCtx) {
    45→    throw new Error('Could not create mask canvas context');
    46→  }
    47→
    48→  // Start with white (all areas to be inpainted)
    49→  maskCtx.fillStyle = 'white';
    50→  maskCtx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    51→
    52→  // Get image data from both canvases
    53→  const sourceImageData = sourceCtx.getImageData(0, 0, width, height);
    54→  const maskImageData = maskCtx.getImageData(0, 0, width, height);
    55→
    56→  // First pass: create initial mask based on alpha threshold
    57→  // Pixels with alpha > threshold are considered solid (black in mask = don't inpaint)
    58→  // Semi-transparent edge pixels will be white (inpaint these areas)
    59→  for (let i = 0; i < sourceImageData.data.length; i += 4) {
    60→    const alpha = sourceImageData.data[i + 3];
    61→
    62→    if (alpha > alphaThreshold) {
    63→      // Solid pixel - mark as black in mask (keep original)
    64→      maskImageData.data[i] = 0;     // R
    65→      maskImageData.data[i + 1] = 0; // G
    66→      maskImageData.data[i + 2] = 0; // B
    67→      maskImageData.data[i + 3] = 255; // A
    68→    } else {
    69→      // Transparent/semi-transparent pixel - mark as white in mask (inpaint this area)
    70→      maskImageData.data[i] = 255;     // R
    71→      maskImageData.data[i + 1] = 255; // G
    72→      maskImageData.data[i + 2] = 255; // B
    73→      maskImageData.data[i + 3] = 255; // A
    74→    }
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  // Second pass: dilate the white (inpaint) region
    78→  // This ensures we eat into the image slightly to eliminate any anti-aliased edge artifacts
    79→  if (dilationPixels > 0) {
    80→    const tempMaskData = new Uint8ClampedArray(maskImageData.data);
    81→
    82→    for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
    83→      for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
    84→        const idx = (y * width + x) * 4;
    85→
    86→        // If this pixel is black (image area), check if any neighbor within dilationPixels is white
    87→        if (tempMaskData[idx] === 0) {
    88→          let shouldDilate = false;
    89→
    90→          // Check neighbors in a square region
    91→          for (let dy = -dilationPixels; dy <= dilationPixels && !shouldDilate; dy++) {
    92→            for (let dx = -dilationPixels; dx <= dilationPixels && !shouldDilate; dx++) {
    93→              const nx = x + dx;
    94→              const ny = y + dy;
    95→
    96→              // Skip out of bounds
    97→              if (nx < 0 || nx >= width || ny < 0 || ny >= height) continue;
    98→
    99→              const neighborIdx = (ny * width + nx) * 4;
   100→              // If neighbor is white (inpaint area), dilate this pixel
   101→              if (tempMaskData[neighborIdx] === 255) {
   102→                shouldDilate = true;
   103→              }
   104→            }
   105→          }
   106→
   107→          if (shouldDilate) {
   108→            // Convert this pixel from black (keep) to white (inpaint)
   109→            maskImageData.data[idx] = 255;     // R
   110→            maskImageData.data[idx + 1] = 255; // G
   111→            maskImageData.data[idx + 2] = 255; // B
   112→            maskImageData.data[idx + 3] = 255; // A
   113→          }
   114→        }
   115→      }
   116→    }
   117→  }
   118→
   119→  maskCtx.putImageData(maskImageData, 0, 0);
   120→
   121→  return maskCanvas;
   122→}
   123→
   124→/**
   125→ * Creates a canvas with a solid background color and the source image drawn on top.
   126→ * This prevents anti-aliased edge pixels from appearing as dark borders by ensuring
   127→ * they blend with the background color.
   128→ *
   129→ * @param sourceCanvas - Canvas with transformed image (may have transparent areas)
   130→ * @param backgroundColor - CSS color for the background (default: '#00FF00' green)
   131→ * @returns Canvas with solid background and image composited on top
   132→ */
   133→export function createCanvasWithBackground(
   134→  sourceCanvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
   135→  backgroundColor: string = '#00FF00'
   136→): HTMLCanvasElement {
   137→  const outputCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
   138→  outputCanvas.width = sourceCanvas.width;
   139→  outputCanvas.height = sourceCanvas.height;
   140→  const outputCtx = outputCanvas.getContext('2d');
   141→
   142→  if (!outputCtx) {
   143→    throw new Error('Could not create output canvas context');
   144→  }
   145→
   146→  // Fill with background color first
   147→  outputCtx.fillStyle = backgroundColor;
   148→  outputCtx.fillRect(0, 0, outputCanvas.width, outputCanvas.height);
   149→
   150→  // Draw transformed image on top - anti-aliased edges will blend with background
   151→  outputCtx.drawImage(sourceCanvas, 0, 0);
   152→
   153→  return outputCanvas;
   154→}
   155→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Clip initialization and pending-clip consumption for the Join Clips tool.
     3→ *
     4→ * Extracted from clipManagerService to isolate:
     5→ * - localStorage cache helpers (skeleton sizing)
     6→ * - Poster preloading
     7→ * - Video duration extraction from URLs
     8→ * - Pending join clips (lightbox "Add to Join" localStorage polling)

    12→
    13→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';

    15→  getPendingJoinClipsCandidateKeys,
    16→  getPendingJoinClipsStorageKey,

    22→import { readUserIdFromStorage } from '@/shared/lib/supabaseSession';
    23→import {

    28→import type { VideoClip, TransitionPrompt } from '../types';
```
