    30→
    31→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    32→// Empty clip factory (canonical location — re-exported by clipManagerService)
    33→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    34→
    35→export function createEmptyClip(): VideoClip {
    36→  return { id: generateUUID(), url: '', loaded: false, playing: false };
    37→}
    38→
    39→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    40→// localStorage cache helpers (skeleton sizing)
    41→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    42→
    43→function getLocalStorageKey(projectId: string): string {
    44→  return `join-clips-count-${projectId}`;
    45→}
    46→
    47→const MAX_CACHED_CLIPS_COUNT = 500;
    48→
    49→export function getCachedClipsCount(projectId: string | null): number {
    50→  if (!projectId) return 0;
    51→  try {
    52→    const cached = localStorage.getItem(getLocalStorageKey(projectId));
    53→    if (!cached) return 0;
    54→
    55→    const parsed = Number.parseInt(cached, 10);
    56→    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed) || parsed < 0 || parsed > MAX_CACHED_CLIPS_COUNT) {
    57→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Invalid join-clips cached count'), {
    58→        context: 'JoinClipsCache.read.invalid',
    59→        showToast: false,
    60→        logData: { projectId, cached },
    61→      });
    62→      return 0;
    63→    }
    64→    return parsed;
    65→  } catch (error) {
    66→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    67→      context: 'JoinClipsCache.read.error',
    68→      showToast: false,
    69→      logData: { projectId },
    70→    });
    71→    return 0;
    72→  }
    73→}
    74→
    75→export function setCachedClipsCount(projectId: string | null, count: number): void {
    76→  if (!projectId) return;
    77→  try {
    78→    const normalizedCount = Number.isFinite(count) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(count)) : 0;
    79→    if (normalizedCount > 0) {
    80→      localStorage.setItem(getLocalStorageKey(projectId), normalizedCount.toString());
    81→    } else {
    82→      localStorage.removeItem(getLocalStorageKey(projectId));
    83→    }
    84→  } catch (error) {
    85→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    86→      context: 'JoinClipsCache.write.error',
    87→      showToast: false,
    88→      logData: { projectId, count },
    89→    });
    90→  }
    91→}
    92→
    93→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    94→// Poster preloading
    95→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    96→
    97→/**
    98→ * Warm the browser image cache for the given poster URLs.
    99→ * Returns a promise that resolves when all images have loaded (or errored).
   100→ */
   101→export function preloadPosterImages(
   102→  posterUrls: string[],
   103→  alreadyPreloaded: Set<string>,
   104→): Promise<void[]> {
   105→  const promises = posterUrls
   106→    .filter(url => url && !alreadyPreloaded.has(url))
   107→    .map(
   108→      url =>
   109→        new Promise<void>(resolve => {
   110→          const img = new Image();
   111→          img.onload = () => {
   112→            alreadyPreloaded.add(url);
   113→            resolve();
   114→          };
   115→          img.onerror = () => resolve();
   116→          img.src = url;
   117→        }),
   118→    );
   119→  return Promise.all(promises);
   120→}
   121→
   122→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   123→// Video duration extraction
   124→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   125→
   126→/** Create a throwaway <video> to read duration from a URL. */
   127→function getVideoDurationFromUrl(videoUrl: string): Promise<number> {
   128→  return new Promise<number>(resolve => {
   129→    const videoElement = document.createElement('video');
   130→    videoElement.preload = 'metadata';
   131→    videoElement.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(videoElement.duration);
   132→    videoElement.onerror = () => resolve(0);
   133→    videoElement.src = videoUrl;
   134→  });
   135→}
   136→
   137→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   138→// Pending join clips (lightbox "Add to Join" localStorage polling)
   139→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   140→
   141→const PENDING_CLIPS_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
   142→
   143→interface PendingJoinClipParseResult {
   144→  entries: PendingJoinClipEntry[];
   145→  invalidCount: number;
   146→}
   147→
   148→function parsePendingJoinClips(raw: string): PendingJoinClipParseResult | null {
   149→  let parsed: unknown;
   150→  try {
   151→    parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
   152→  } catch {
   153→    return null;
   154→  }
   155→
   156→  if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {
   157→    return null;
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  const entries: PendingJoinClipEntry[] = [];
   161→  let invalidCount = 0;
   162→  for (const value of parsed) {
   163→    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
   164→      invalidCount += 1;
   165→      continue;
   166→    }
   167→
   168→    const candidate = value as Record<string, unknown>;
   169→    if (
   170→      typeof candidate.videoUrl !== 'string'
   171→      || typeof candidate.generationId !== 'string'
   172→      || typeof candidate.timestamp !== 'number'
   173→      || !Number.isFinite(candidate.timestamp)
   174→    ) {
   175→      invalidCount += 1;
   176→      continue;
   177→    }
   178→
   179→    entries.push({
   180→      videoUrl: candidate.videoUrl,
   181→      generationId: candidate.generationId,
   182→      timestamp: candidate.timestamp,
   183→      ...(typeof candidate.thumbnailUrl === 'string' && candidate.thumbnailUrl.length > 0
   184→        ? { thumbnailUrl: candidate.thumbnailUrl }
   185→        : {}),
   186→      ...(typeof candidate.projectId === 'string' && candidate.projectId.length > 0
   187→        ? { projectId: candidate.projectId }
   188→        : {}),
   189→      ...(typeof candidate.userId === 'string' && candidate.userId.length > 0
   190→        ? { userId: candidate.userId }
   191→        : {}),
   192→    });
   193→  }
   194→
   195→  return { entries, invalidCount };
   196→}
   197→
   198→/**
   199→ * Reads and consumes pending join clips from localStorage.
   200→ * Returns deferred actions that are applied to clip state later.
   201→ * Placement is intentionally not resolved here because only the consumer has
   202→ * the previous clip array needed to choose fill-vs-append.
   203→ */
   204→export type PendingClipAction = {
   205→  type: 'deferred_insert';
   206→  clip: VideoClip;
   207→};
   208→
   209→interface ConsumePendingJoinClipsOptions {
   210→  projectId?: string | null;
   211→  readVideoDuration?: (videoUrl: string) => Promise<number>;
   212→}
   213→
   214→async function toPendingClipActions(
   215→  entries: PendingJoinClipEntry[],
   216→  readVideoDuration: (videoUrl: string) => Promise<number>,
   217→): Promise<PendingClipAction[]> {
   218→  const actions: PendingClipAction[] = [];
   219→
   220→  for (const { videoUrl, thumbnailUrl, generationId } of entries) {
   221→    if (!videoUrl) continue;
   222→
   223→    const durationSeconds = await readVideoDuration(videoUrl);
   224→
   225→    const clip: VideoClip = {
   226→      id: generateUUID(),
   227→      url: videoUrl,
   228→      posterUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   229→      durationSeconds,
   230→      loaded: false,
   231→      playing: false,
   232→      generationId,
   233→    };
   234→
   235→    actions.push({ type: 'deferred_insert', clip });
   236→  }
   237→
   238→  return actions;
   239→}
   240→
   241→export async function consumePendingJoinClips(
   242→  options: ConsumePendingJoinClipsOptions = {},
   243→): Promise<OperationResult<PendingClipAction[]>> {
   244→  const projectId = options.projectId ?? null;
   245→  const readVideoDuration = options.readVideoDuration ?? getVideoDurationFromUrl;
   246→
   247→  try {
   248→    const userId = readUserIdFromStorage();
   249→
   250→    const inMemoryPending = consumeJoinClipsIntents({ projectId, userId });
   251→    if (inMemoryPending.length > 0) {
   252→      const now = Date.now();
   253→      const scopedRecentClips = inMemoryPending.filter(
   254→        (clip) =>
   255→          now - clip.timestamp < PENDING_CLIPS_TTL_MS
   256→          && isPendingJoinClipInScope(clip, { projectId, userId }),
   257→      );
   258→      if (scopedRecentClips.length === 0) {
   259→        localStorage.removeItem(getPendingJoinClipsStorageKey(projectId, userId));
   260→        return operationSuccess([]);
   261→      }
   262→
   263→      const actions = await toPendingClipActions(scopedRecentClips, readVideoDuration);
   264→      localStorage.removeItem(getPendingJoinClipsStorageKey(projectId, userId));
   265→      return operationSuccess(actions);
   266→    }
   267→
   268→    const pendingKeys = getPendingJoinClipsCandidateKeys({ projectId, userId });
   269→    const pendingSource = pendingKeys
   270→      .map((key) => ({ key, raw: localStorage.getItem(key) }))
   271→      .find((item) => typeof item.raw === 'string' && item.raw.length > 0);
   272→
   273→    if (!pendingSource || !pendingSource.raw) {
   274→      return operationSuccess([]);
   275→    }
   276→
   277→    const parsedPendingClips = parsePendingJoinClips(pendingSource.raw);
   278→    if (!parsedPendingClips) {
   279→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Invalid pending join clips payload'), {
   280→        context: 'JoinClipsPage.pendingClipsInvalid',
   281→        showToast: false,
   282→        logData: { [REDACTED] },
   283→      });
   284→      localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   285→      return operationFailure(new Error('Invalid pending join clips payload'), {
   286→        policy: 'degrade',
   287→        errorCode: 'pending_join_clips_invalid_payload',
   288→        message: 'Invalid pending join clips payload',
   289→        recoverable: true,
   290→        cause: { [REDACTED] },
   291→      });
   292→    }
   293→
   294→    if (parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0) {
   295→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Dropped invalid pending join clip entries'), {
   296→        context: 'JoinClipsPage.pendingClipsPartialRecovery',
   297→        showToast: false,
   298→        logData: {
   299→          [REDACTED],
   300→          totalEntries: parsedPendingClips.entries.length + parsedPendingClips.invalidCount,
   301→          invalidEntries: parsedPendingClips.invalidCount,
   302→        },
   303→      });
   304→    }
   305→
   306→    const now = Date.now();
   307→    const recentClips = parsedPendingClips.entries.filter(
   308→      clip => now - clip.timestamp < PENDING_CLIPS_TTL_MS,
   309→    );
   310→    const scopedRecentClips = recentClips.filter((clip) =>
   311→      isPendingJoinClipInScope(clip, { projectId, userId }),
   312→    );
   313→
   314→    if (scopedRecentClips.length === 0) {
   315→      localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   316→      return operationSuccess([], {
   317→        ...(parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0 ? { policy: 'degrade' } : {}),
   318→      });
   319→    }
   320→
   321→    const actions = await toPendingClipActions(scopedRecentClips, readVideoDuration);
   322→
   323→    localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   324→    return operationSuccess(actions, {
   325→      ...(parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0 ? { policy: 'degrade' } : {}),
   326→    });
   327→  } catch (error) {
   328→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'JoinClipsPage', showToast: false });
   329→    return operationFailure(error, {
   330→      policy: 'degrade',
   331→      errorCode: 'pending_join_clips_read_failed',
   332→      message: 'Failed to consume pending join clips',
   333→      recoverable: true,
   334→      cause: error,
   335→    });
   336→  }
   337→}
   338→
   339→/**
   340→ * Apply pending clip actions to an existing clips array.
   341→ * Resolves each deferred action by filling the first available empty slot,
   342→ * or appending when no empty slots remain.
   343→ */
   344→export function applyPendingClipActions(
   345→  prevClips: VideoClip[],
   346→  actions: PendingClipAction[],
   347→): VideoClip[] {
   348→  let clips = [...prevClips];
   349→  // Track which indices have been filled by previous actions in this batch
   350→  const filledIndices = new Set<number>();
   351→
   352→  for (const action of actions) {
   353→    const emptyIndex = clips.findIndex(
   354→      (clip, idx) => !clip.url && !filledIndices.has(idx),
   355→    );
   356→
   357→    if (emptyIndex !== -1) {
   358→      clips = clips.map((clip, idx) =>
   359→        idx === emptyIndex
   360→          ? {
   361→              ...clip,
   362→              url: action.clip.url,
   363→              posterUrl: action.clip.posterUrl,
   364→              durationSeconds: action.clip.durationSeconds,
   365→              loaded: false,
   366→              playing: false,
   367→              generationId: action.clip.generationId,
   368→            }
   369→          : clip,
   370→      );
   371→      filledIndices.add(emptyIndex);
   372→    } else {
   373→      clips = [...clips, action.clip];
   374→    }
   375→  }
   376→
   377→  return clips;
   378→}
   379→
   380→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   381→// Build initial clips from persisted settings
   382→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   383→
   384→interface InitialClipsResult {
   385→  clips: VideoClip[];
   386→  transitionPrompts: TransitionPrompt[];
   387→  posterUrlsToPreload: string[];
   388→}
   389→
   390→export function buildInitialClipsFromSettings(
   391→  settings: JoinClipsSettings,
   392→): InitialClipsResult {
   393→  const initialClips: VideoClip[] = [];
   394→  const posterUrlsToPreload: string[] = [];
   395→  let transitionPrompts: TransitionPrompt[] = [];
   396→
   397→  // Try loading from new multi-clip format
   398→  if (settings.clips && settings.clips.length > 0) {
   399→    settings.clips.forEach(clip => {
   400→      if (clip.url) {
   401→        initialClips.push({
   402→          id: generateUUID(),
   403→          url: clip.url,
   404→          posterUrl: clip.posterUrl,
   405→          finalFrameUrl: clip.finalFrameUrl,
   406→          durationSeconds: clip.durationSeconds,
   407→          loaded: false,
   408→          playing: false,
   409→        });
   410→        if (clip.posterUrl) posterUrlsToPreload.push(clip.posterUrl);
   411→      }
   412→    });
   413→
   414→    // Load transition prompts
   415→    if (settings.transitionPrompts && settings.transitionPrompts.length > 0) {
   416→      transitionPrompts = settings.transitionPrompts
   417→        .map(tp => ({
   418→          id: initialClips[tp.clipIndex]?.id || '',
   419→          prompt: tp.prompt,
   420→        }))
   421→        .filter(p => p.id);
   422→    }
   423→  }
   424→  // Fallback to legacy two-video format
   425→  else if (settings.startingVideoUrl || settings.endingVideoUrl) {
   426→    if (settings.startingVideoUrl) {
   427→      initialClips.push({
   428→        id: generateUUID(),
   429→        url: settings.startingVideoUrl,
   430→        posterUrl: settings.startingVideoPosterUrl,
   431→        loaded: false,
   432→        playing: false,
   433→      });
   434→      if (settings.startingVideoPosterUrl) {
   435→        posterUrlsToPreload.push(settings.startingVideoPosterUrl);
   436→      }
   437→    }
   438→
   439→    if (settings.endingVideoUrl) {
   440→      initialClips.push({
   441→        id: generateUUID(),
   442→        url: settings.endingVideoUrl,
   443→        posterUrl: settings.endingVideoPosterUrl,
   444→        loaded: false,
   445→        playing: false,
   446→      });
   447→      if (settings.endingVideoPosterUrl) {
   448→        posterUrlsToPreload.push(settings.endingVideoPosterUrl);
   449→      }
   450→    }
   451→
   452→    // Initialize transition prompts from legacy format
   453→    // The `prompt` field existed in an older settings schema and may still
   454→    // be present in persisted data even though it's not in the current type.
   455→    const legacyPrompt = (settings as JoinClipsSettings & { prompt?: string }).prompt;
   456→    if (initialClips.length >= 2 && legacyPrompt) {
   457→      transitionPrompts = [
   458→        {
   459→          id: initialClips[1].id,
   460→          prompt: legacyPrompt,
   461→        },
   462→      ];
   463→    }
   464→  }
   465→
   466→  return { clips: initialClips, transitionPrompts, posterUrlsToPreload };
   467→}
   468→
   469→/**
   470→ * Pad initialClips to have at least 2 slots plus one trailing empty slot.
   471→ * This matches the original hook behavior exactly.
   472→ */
   473→export function padClipsWithEmptySlots(initialClips: VideoClip[]): VideoClip[] {
   474→  if (initialClips.length === 0) {
   475→    return [createEmptyClip(), createEmptyClip()];
   476→  }
   477→
   478→  if (initialClips.length < 2) {
   479→    const clipsToAdd = 2 - initialClips.length;
   480→    const emptyClips = Array.from({ length: clipsToAdd }, () => createEmptyClip());
   481→    return [...initialClips, ...emptyClips];
   482→  }
   483→
   484→  // >= 2 clips: add one trailing empty slot
   485→  return [...initialClips, createEmptyClip()];
   486→}
   487→

     5→// TypeScript declaration for global mobile video preload map
     6→declare global {
     7→  interface Window {
     8→    mobileVideoPreloadMap?: Map<number, () => void>;
     9→  }
    10→}
    11→
    12→/**
    13→ * Hook to handle mobile video preloading via hidden <video> elements.
    14→ * Creates a preload video element on first tap and exposes the preload function
    15→ * to the parent via a global map keyed by originalIndex.
    16→ */
    17→export function useMobileVideoPreload(
    18→  video: GenerationRow,
    19→  originalIndex: number,
    20→  isMobile: boolean,
    21→  onMobilePreload: ((index: number) => void) | undefined
    22→): { isMobilePreloading: boolean } {
    23→  const [isMobilePreloading, setIsMobilePreloading] = useState(false);
    24→  const preloadVideoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
    25→
    26→  const startMobileVideoPreload = React.useCallback(() => {
    27→    if (!isMobile || isMobilePreloading || preloadVideoRef.current) {
    28→      return;
    29→    }
    30→
    31→    setIsMobilePreloading(true);
    32→
    33→    // Create hidden video element for preloading
    34→    const preloadVideo = document.createElement('video');
    35→    const resolvedSrc = getDisplayUrl((video.location || video.imageUrl || '') as string);
    36→    preloadVideo.src = resolvedSrc;
    37→    preloadVideo.preload = 'auto';
    38→    preloadVideo.muted = true;
    39→    preloadVideo.playsInline = true;
    40→    preloadVideo.style.display = 'none';
    41→    preloadVideo.style.position = 'absolute';
    42→    preloadVideo.style.top = '-9999px';
    43→    preloadVideo.style.left = '-9999px';
    44→
    45→    // Log errors for debugging
    46→    const handleError = () => {
    47→    };
    48→
    49→    preloadVideo.addEventListener('error', handleError);
    50→
    51→    // Store ref and append to DOM (hidden)
    52→    preloadVideoRef.current = preloadVideo;
    53→    document.body.appendChild(preloadVideo);
    54→
    55→    // Cleanup function
    56→    const cleanup = () => {
    57→      if (preloadVideoRef.current) {
    58→        preloadVideoRef.current.removeEventListener('error', handleError);
    59→        if (preloadVideoRef.current.parentNode) {
    60→          preloadVideoRef.current.parentNode.removeChild(preloadVideoRef.current);
    61→        }
    62→        preloadVideoRef.current = null;
    63→      }
    64→    };
    65→
    66→    // Auto-cleanup after 30 seconds if video not opened
    67→    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
    68→      cleanup();
    69→      setIsMobilePreloading(false);
    70→    }, 30000);
    71→
    72→    // Store cleanup function for manual cleanup
    73→    preloadVideo.dataset.cleanupTimeoutId = timeoutId.toString();
    74→
    75→    return cleanup;
    76→  }, [isMobile, isMobilePreloading, video.location, video.imageUrl]);
    77→
    78→  // Cleanup preload video on unmount or video change
    79→  useEffect(() => {
    80→    return () => {
    81→      if (preloadVideoRef.current) {
    82→        const timeoutId = preloadVideoRef.current.dataset.cleanupTimeoutId;
    83→        if (timeoutId) {
    84→          clearTimeout(parseInt(timeoutId));
    85→        }
    86→        if (preloadVideoRef.current.parentNode) {
    87→          preloadVideoRef.current.parentNode.removeChild(preloadVideoRef.current);
    88→        }
    89→        preloadVideoRef.current = null;
    90→      }
    91→    };
    92→  }, [video.location, video.imageUrl]);
    93→
    94→  // Create stable preload handler for this video item
    95→  const handleMobilePreload = React.useCallback(() => {
    96→    startMobileVideoPreload();
    97→  }, [startMobileVideoPreload]);
    98→
    99→  // Expose preload function to parent via global map keyed by originalIndex
   100→  React.useEffect(() => {
   101→    if (onMobilePreload) {
   102→      if (!window.mobileVideoPreloadMap) {
   103→        window.mobileVideoPreloadMap = new Map();
   104→      }
   105→      window.mobileVideoPreloadMap.set(originalIndex, handleMobilePreload);
   106→
   107→      return () => {
   108→        window.mobileVideoPreloadMap?.delete(originalIndex);
   109→      };
   110→    }
   111→  }, [originalIndex, handleMobilePreload, onMobilePreload]);
   112→
   113→  return { isMobilePreloading };
   114→}

     9→
    10→/**
    11→ * Hook that provides video metadata, extracting it from the URL if not provided.
    12→ *
    13→ * @param videoUrl - URL of the video
    14→ * @param providedMetadata - Pre-existing metadata (if available)
    15→ * @param options - Optional callbacks
    16→ * @returns { metadata, isExtracting }
    17→ *
    18→ * @example
    19→ * const { metadata, isExtracting } = useVideoMetadata(videoUrl, existingMetadata, {
    20→ *   onExtracted: (m) => saveToDatabase(m),
    21→ * });
    22→ */
    23→export function useVideoMetadata(
    24→  videoUrl: string,
    25→  providedMetadata: VideoMetadata | null,
    26→  options: UseVideoMetadataOptions = {}
    27→) {
    28→  const { onExtracted } = options;
    29→
    30→  const [extractedMetadata, setExtractedMetadata] = useState<VideoMetadata | null>(null);
    31→  const [isExtracting, setIsExtracting] = useState(false);
    32→
    33→  // Use provided metadata or extracted metadata
    34→  const metadata = providedMetadata || extractedMetadata;
    35→
    36→  // Extract metadata from URL if not provided
    37→  useEffect(() => {
    38→    if (!providedMetadata && !isExtracting && !extractedMetadata) {
    39→      setIsExtracting(true);
    40→
    41→      extractVideoMetadataFromUrl(videoUrl)
    42→        .then((meta) => {
    43→          setExtractedMetadata(meta);
    44→
    45→          if (onExtracted) {
    46→            onExtracted(meta);
    47→          }
    48→        })
    49→        .catch((error) => {
    50→          normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useVideoMetadata', showToast: false });
    51→        })
    52→        .finally(() => {
    53→          setIsExtracting(false);
    54→        });
    55→    }
    56→  }, [videoUrl, providedMetadata, isExtracting, extractedMetadata, onExtracted]);
    57→
    58→  return { metadata, isExtracting };
    59→}

   109→    generationId: actualGenerationId,
   110→    projectId: projectId ?? null,
   111→  });
   112→
   113→  const variants = useVariants({
   114→    generationId: actualGenerationId,
   115→    enabled: true,
   116→  });
   117→
   118→  return { editSettings, variants };
   119→}

   121→type InlineEditPersistence = ReturnType<typeof useInlineEditPersistence>;
   122→
   123→function useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(
   124→  media: GenerationRow,
   125→  env: InlineEditEnvironment,
   126→  persistence: InlineEditPersistence,
   127→) {
   128→  const handleExitInpaintModeRef = useRef<() => void>(() => {});
   129→
   130→  const inpainting = useInpainting({
   131→    media,
   132→    selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   133→    isVideo: env.isVideo,
   134→    imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   135→    imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   136→    handleExitInpaintMode: () => handleExitInpaintModeRef.current(),
   137→    loras: env.loraState.editModeLoRAs,
   138→    toolTypeOverride: TOOL_IDS.EDIT_IMAGES,
   139→    activeVariantId: persistence.variants.activeVariant?.id,
   140→    activeVariantLocation: persistence.variants.activeVariant?.location,
   141→    createAsGeneration: env.createAsGeneration,
   142→    advancedSettings: persistence.editSettings.advancedSettings,
   143→    qwenEditModel: persistence.editSettings.qwenEditModel,
   144→    initialActive: true,
   145→  });
   146→
   147→  const magic = useMagicEditMode({
   148→    media,
   149→    selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   150→    isInpaintMode: inpainting.isInpaintMode,
   151→    setIsInpaintMode: (v: boolean) => inpainting.setIsInpaintMode(v),
   152→    handleEnterInpaintMode: inpainting.handleEnterInpaintMode,
   153→    handleGenerateInpaint: inpainting.handleGenerateInpaint,
   154→    brushStrokes: inpainting.brushStrokes,
   155→    inpaintPrompt: inpainting.inpaintPrompt,
   156→    setInpaintPrompt: inpainting.setInpaintPrompt,
   157→    inpaintNumGenerations: inpainting.inpaintNumGenerations,
   158→    setInpaintNumGenerations: inpainting.setInpaintNumGenerations,
   159→    editModeLoRAs: env.loraState.editModeLoRAs,
   160→    sourceUrlForTasks: env.effectiveImageUrl,
   161→    imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   162→    isInSceneBoostEnabled: env.loraState.isInSceneBoostEnabled,
   163→    setIsInSceneBoostEnabled: env.loraState.setIsInSceneBoostEnabled,
   164→    toolTypeOverride: TOOL_IDS.EDIT_IMAGES,
   165→    activeVariantLocation: persistence.variants.activeVariant?.location,
   166→    createAsGeneration: env.createAsGeneration,
   167→    advancedSettings: persistence.editSettings.advancedSettings,
   168→    qwenEditModel: persistence.editSettings.qwenEditModel,
   169→    initialActive: true,
   170→  });
   171→
   172→  handleExitInpaintModeRef.current = () => {
   173→    inpainting.setIsInpaintMode(false);
   174→    magic.setIsMagicEditMode(false);
   175→  };
   176→
   177→  return { inpainting, magic };
   178→}

   261→interface InlineEditStateModelsInput {
   262→  env: InlineEditEnvironment;

   271→
   272→function buildInlineEditStateModels(input: InlineEditStateModelsInput) {
   273→  const { env, persistence, inpainting, magic, reposition, img2img, starToggle, handleDownload } = input;
   274→
   275→  const inpaintingState: InlineEditStateResult['inpaintingState'] = {
   276→    isInpaintMode: inpainting.isInpaintMode,
   277→    editMode: inpainting.editMode,
   278→    brushStrokes: inpainting.brushStrokes,
   279→    currentStroke: inpainting.currentStroke,
   280→    isDrawing: inpainting.isDrawing,
   281→    isEraseMode: inpainting.isEraseMode,
   282→    brushSize: inpainting.brushSize,
   283→    annotationMode: inpainting.annotationMode,
   284→    selectedShapeId: inpainting.selectedShapeId,
   285→    isAnnotateMode: inpainting.isAnnotateMode,
   286→    handleKonvaPointerDown: inpainting.handleKonvaPointerDown,
   287→    handleKonvaPointerMove: inpainting.handleKonvaPointerMove,
   288→    handleKonvaPointerUp: inpainting.handleKonvaPointerUp,
   289→    handleShapeClick: inpainting.handleShapeClick,
   290→    strokeOverlayRef: inpainting.strokeOverlayRef,
   291→    getDeleteButtonPosition: inpainting.getDeleteButtonPosition,
   292→    handleToggleFreeForm: inpainting.handleToggleFreeForm,
   293→    handleDeleteSelected: inpainting.handleDeleteSelected,
   294→    handleUndo: inpainting.handleUndo,
   295→    handleClearMask: inpainting.handleClearMask,
   296→    setIsInpaintMode: inpainting.setIsInpaintMode,
   297→    setEditMode: inpainting.setEditMode,
   298→    setBrushSize: inpainting.setBrushSize,
   299→    setIsEraseMode: inpainting.setIsEraseMode,
   300→    setAnnotationMode: inpainting.setAnnotationMode,
   301→    isSpecialEditMode: magic.isSpecialEditMode,
   302→    handleEnterMagicEditMode: magic.handleEnterMagicEditMode,
   303→  };
   304→
   305→  const transformState: InlineEditStateResult['transformState'] = {
   306→    repositionTransform: reposition.transform,
   307→    setScale: reposition.setScale,
   308→    setRotation: reposition.setRotation,
   309→    toggleFlipH: reposition.toggleFlipH,
   310→    toggleFlipV: reposition.toggleFlipV,
   311→    resetTransform: reposition.resetTransform,
   312→    getTransformStyle: reposition.getTransformStyle,
   313→  };
   314→
   315→  const generationState: InlineEditStateResult['generationState'] = {
   316→    localStarred: starToggle.localStarred,
   317→    toggleStarMutation: starToggle.toggleStarMutation,
   318→    handleToggleStar: starToggle.handleToggleStar,
   319→    handleDownload,
   320→    handleUnifiedGenerate: magic.handleUnifiedGenerate,
   321→    handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit: inpainting.handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit,
   322→    handleGenerateReposition: reposition.handleGenerateReposition,
   323→    handleSaveAsVariant: reposition.handleSaveAsVariant,
   324→    handleGenerateImg2Img: img2img.handleGenerateImg2Img,
   325→    img2imgLoraManager: img2img.loraManager,
   326→  };
   327→
   328→  const imageEditValue = buildImageEditStateValue({
   329→    inpainting,
   330→    magic,
   331→    reposition,
   332→    img2img,
   333→    imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   334→    handleExitInpaintMode: () => inpainting.setIsInpaintMode(false),
   335→    setEditMode: (mode: ImageEditMode) => inpainting.setEditMode(toInpaintingEditMode(mode)),
   336→    loraMode: env.loraState.loraMode,
   337→    setLoraMode: env.loraState.setLoraMode,
   338→    customLoraUrl: env.loraState.customLoraUrl,
   339→    setCustomLoraUrl: env.loraState.setCustomLoraUrl,
   340→    createAsGeneration: env.createAsGeneration,
   341→    setCreateAsGeneration: env.setCreateAsGeneration,
   342→    qwenEditModel: persistence.editSettings.qwenEditModel,
   343→    setQwenEditModel: persistence.editSettings.setQwenEditModel,
   344→    advancedSettings: persistence.editSettings.advancedSettings,
   345→    setAdvancedSettings: persistence.editSettings.setAdvancedSettings,
   346→  });
   347→
   348→  return {
   349→    inpaintingState,
   350→    transformState,
   351→    generationState,
   352→    imageEditValue,
   353→  };
   354→}
   355→
   356→export interface InlineEditStateResult {
   357→  media: GenerationRow;
   358→  canvasEnvironment: {
   359→    isMobile: boolean;

   361→    isCloudMode: boolean;

   369→  };
   370→  inpaintingState: {
   371→    isInpaintMode: boolean;
   372→    editMode: InpaintingHookResult['editMode'];
   373→    brushStrokes: InpaintingHookResult['brushStrokes'];
   374→    currentStroke: InpaintingHookResult['currentStroke'];
   375→    isDrawing: boolean;
   376→    isEraseMode: boolean;
   377→    brushSize: number;
   378→    annotationMode: InpaintingHookResult['annotationMode'];
   379→    selectedShapeId: string | null;
   380→    isAnnotateMode: boolean;
   381→    handleKonvaPointerDown: InpaintingHookResult['handleKonvaPointerDown'];
   382→    handleKonvaPointerMove: InpaintingHookResult['handleKonvaPointerMove'];
   383→    handleKonvaPointerUp: InpaintingHookResult['handleKonvaPointerUp'];
   384→    handleShapeClick: InpaintingHookResult['handleShapeClick'];
   385→    strokeOverlayRef: InpaintingHookResult['strokeOverlayRef'];
   386→    getDeleteButtonPosition: InpaintingHookResult['getDeleteButtonPosition'];
   387→    handleToggleFreeForm: InpaintingHookResult['handleToggleFreeForm'];
   388→    handleDeleteSelected: InpaintingHookResult['handleDeleteSelected'];
   389→    handleUndo: InpaintingHookResult['handleUndo'];
   390→    handleClearMask: InpaintingHookResult['handleClearMask'];
   391→    setIsInpaintMode: InpaintingHookResult['setIsInpaintMode'];
   392→    setEditMode: InpaintingHookResult['setEditMode'];
   393→    setBrushSize: InpaintingHookResult['setBrushSize'];
   394→    setIsEraseMode: InpaintingHookResult['setIsEraseMode'];
   395→    setAnnotationMode: InpaintingHookResult['setAnnotationMode'];
   396→    isSpecialEditMode: boolean;
   397→    handleEnterMagicEditMode: MagicEditHookResult['handleEnterMagicEditMode'];
   398→  };
   399→  transformState: {
   400→    repositionTransform: RepositionHookResult['transform'];
   401→    setScale: RepositionHookResult['setScale'];
   402→    setRotation: RepositionHookResult['setRotation'];
   403→    toggleFlipH: RepositionHookResult['toggleFlipH'];
   404→    toggleFlipV: RepositionHookResult['toggleFlipV'];
   405→    resetTransform: RepositionHookResult['resetTransform'];
   406→    getTransformStyle: RepositionHookResult['getTransformStyle'];
   407→  };
   408→  generationState: {
   409→    localStarred: StarToggleHookResult['localStarred'];
   410→    toggleStarMutation: StarToggleHookResult['toggleStarMutation'];
   411→    handleToggleStar: StarToggleHookResult['handleToggleStar'];
   412→    handleDownload: () => Promise<void>;
   413→    handleUnifiedGenerate: MagicEditHookResult['handleUnifiedGenerate'];
   414→    handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit: InpaintingHookResult['handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit'];
   415→    handleGenerateReposition: RepositionHookResult['handleGenerateReposition'];
   416→    handleSaveAsVariant: RepositionHookResult['handleSaveAsVariant'];
   417→    handleGenerateImg2Img: Img2ImgHookResult['handleGenerateImg2Img'];
   418→    img2imgLoraManager: Img2ImgHookResult['loraManager'];
   419→  };
   420→  variants: {
   421→    variants: InlineEditPersistence['variants']['variants'];
   422→    activeVariant: InlineEditPersistence['variants']['activeVariant'];
   423→    isLoading: boolean;
   424→    setActiveVariantId: InlineEditPersistence['variants']['setActiveVariantId'];
   425→    setPrimaryVariant: InlineEditPersistence['variants']['setPrimaryVariant'];
   426→    deleteVariant: InlineEditPersistence['variants']['deleteVariant'];
   427→  };
   428→  sourceGenerationData: SourceGenerationData;
   429→  availableLoras: PublicLorasData;
   430→  imageEditValue: ImageEditValue;
   431→}
   432→
   433→export function useInlineEditState(
   434→  media: GenerationRow,
   435→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   436→): InlineEditStateResult {
   437→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   438→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   439→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   440→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   441→
   442→  useEffect(() => {
   443→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   444→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   445→
   446→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   447→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   448→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   449→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   450→
   451→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   452→
   453→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   454→    media,
   455→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   456→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   457→      : undefined,
   458→  });
   459→
   460→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   461→
   462→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   463→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   464→  };
   465→
   466→  const {
   467→    inpaintingState,
   468→    transformState,
   469→    generationState,
   470→    imageEditValue,
   471→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   472→    env,
   473→    persistence,
   474→    inpainting,
   475→    magic,
   476→    reposition,
   477→    img2img,
   478→    starToggle,
   479→    handleDownload,
   480→  });
   481→
   482→  return {
   483→    media,
   484→    canvasEnvironment: {
   485→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   486→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   487→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   488→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   489→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   490→      effectiveImageUrl,
   491→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   492→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   493→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   494→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   495→    },
   496→    inpaintingState,
   497→    transformState,
   498→    generationState,
   499→    variants: {
   500→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   501→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   502→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   503→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   504→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   505→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,
   506→    },
   507→    sourceGenerationData,
   508→    availableLoras,
   509→    imageEditValue,
   510→  } satisfies InlineEditStateResult;
   511→}
   512→

   130→    if described or noted:
   131→        print(f"  Annotations:      {described} described, {noted} noted")
   132→    if active:
   133→        print(f"  Focus:            {active}")
   134→    if superseded:
   135→        print(f"  Disappeared:      {superseded} (resolved or removed since last scan)")
   136→
   137→    # Commit tracking summary
   138→    _cfg = load_config()
   139→    if _cfg.get("commit_tracking_enabled", True):
   140→        ct = commit_tracking_summary(plan)
   141→        if ct["total"] > 0:
   142→            pr_num = _cfg.get("commit_pr", 0)
   143→            pr_str = f"  PR: #{pr_num}" if pr_num else ""
   144→            print(
   145→                f"  Commit tracking:  {ct['uncommitted']} uncommitted, "
   146→                f"{ct['committed']} committed ({ct['total']} issues){pr_str}"
   147→            )
   148→
   149→
   150→def _cmd_plan_reset(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   151→    """Reset the plan to empty."""
   152→    plan = load_plan()
   153→    queue_len = len(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   154→    cluster_count = len(plan.get("clusters", {}))
   155→    reset_plan(plan)
   156→    append_log_entry(
   157→        plan, "reset", actor="user",
   158→        detail={"previous_queue_size": queue_len, "previous_cluster_count": cluster_count},
   159→    )
   160→    save_plan(plan)
   161→    print(colorize("  Plan reset to empty.", "green"))
   162→
   163→
   164→_PLAN_ACTION_HANDLERS = {
   165→    "show": _cmd_plan_show,
   166→    "queue": cmd_plan_queue,
   167→    "reset": _cmd_plan_reset,
   168→    "reorder": cmd_plan_reorder,
   169→    "describe": cmd_plan_describe,
   170→    "resolve": cmd_plan_resolve,
   171→    "note": cmd_plan_note,
   172→    "focus": cmd_plan_focus,
   173→    "skip": cmd_plan_skip,
   174→    "unskip": cmd_plan_unskip,
   175→    "reopen": cmd_plan_reopen,
   176→    "cluster": cmd_cluster_dispatch,
   177→    "triage": cmd_plan_triage,
   178→    "commit-log": cmd_commit_log_dispatch,
   179→}
   180→
   181→
   182→def cmd_plan(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   183→    """Dispatch plan subcommand or generate markdown output."""
   184→    plan_action = getattr(args, "plan_action", None)
   185→    if plan_action is None:
   186→        _cmd_plan_generate(args)
   187→        return
   188→
   189→    handler = _PLAN_ACTION_HANDLERS.get(plan_action)
   190→    if handler is None:
   191→        print(f"Unknown plan action: {plan_action}")
   192→        return

1→"""Path resolution and exclusion matching helpers."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import fnmatch
     6→import os
     7→import tempfile
     8→from pathlib import Path
     9→
    10→from desloppify.base.discovery.paths import get_project_root
    11→
    12→
    13→def matches_exclusion(rel_path: str, exclusion: str) -> bool:
    14→    """Check if a relative path matches an exclusion pattern."""
    15→    parts = Path(rel_path).parts
    16→    if exclusion in parts:
    17→        return True
    18→    if "*" in exclusion:
    19→        if any(fnmatch.fnmatch(part, exclusion) for part in parts):
    20→            return True
    21→        # Full-path glob match for patterns with directory separators
    22→        # (e.g. "Wan2GP/**" should match "Wan2GP/models/rf.py").
    23→        if "/" in exclusion or os.sep in exclusion:
    24→            normalized_path = rel_path.lstrip("./")
    25→            if fnmatch.fnmatch(normalized_path, exclusion):
    26→                return True
    27→    if "/" in exclusion or os.sep in exclusion:
    28→        normalized = exclusion.rstrip("/").rstrip(os.sep)
    29→        return rel_path == normalized or rel_path.startswith(normalized + "/") or rel_path.startswith(
    30→            normalized + os.sep
    31→        )
    32→    return False
    33→
    34→
    35→def normalize_path_separators(path: str) -> str:
    36→    return path.replace("\\", "/")
    37→
    38→
    39→def safe_relpath(path: str | Path, start: str | Path) -> str:
    40→    try:
    41→        return os.path.relpath(str(path), str(start))
    42→    except ValueError:
    43→        return str(Path(path).resolve())
    44→
    45→
    46→def rel(path: str) -> str:
    47→    root = get_project_root()
    48→    resolved = Path(path).resolve()
    49→    try:
    50→        return normalize_path_separators(str(resolved.relative_to(root)))
    51→    except ValueError:
    52→        return normalize_path_separators(safe_relpath(resolved, root))
    53→
    54→
    55→def resolve_path(filepath: str) -> str:
    56→    """Resolve a filepath to absolute, handling both relative and absolute."""
    57→    p = Path(filepath)
    58→    if p.is_absolute():
    59→        return str(p.resolve())
    60→    return str((get_project_root() / filepath).resolve())
    61→
    62→
    63→def resolve_scan_file(
    64→    filepath: str | Path,
    65→    *,
    66→    scan_root: str | Path | None = None,
    67→) -> Path:
    68→    """Resolve a scan file path with explicit scan-root-first semantics.
    69→
    70→    Relative file paths are resolved against ``scan_root`` first (when provided)
    71→    and then against the process project root as a fallback.
    72→    """
    73→    p = Path(filepath)
    74→    if p.is_absolute():
    75→        return p.resolve()
    76→
    77→    root = get_project_root()
    78→    if scan_root is not None:
    79→        scan_root_path = Path(scan_root)
    80→        scan_root_abs = (
    81→            scan_root_path.resolve()
    82→            if scan_root_path.is_absolute()
    83→            else (root / scan_root_path).resolve()
    84→        )
    85→        scan_candidate = (scan_root_abs / p).resolve()
    86→        if scan_candidate.exists():
    87→            return scan_candidate
    88→
    89→    return (root / p).resolve()
    90→
    91→
    92→def safe_write_text(filepath: str | Path, content: str) -> None:
    93→    """Atomically write text to a file using temp+rename."""
    94→    p = Path(filepath)
    95→    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    96→    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=p.parent, suffix=".tmp")
    97→    try:
    98→        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
    99→            f.write(content)
   100→        os.replace(tmp, str(p))
   101→    except OSError:
   102→        if os.path.exists(tmp):
   103→            os.unlink(tmp)
   104→        raise
   105→
   106→
   107→def count_lines(path: Path) -> int:
   108→    """Count lines in a file without loading full contents into memory."""
   109→    count = 0
   110→    try:
   111→        with path.open("rb") as handle:
   112→            for _ in handle:
   113→                count += 1
   114→    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
   115→        return 0
   116→    return count
   117→
   118→
   119→__all__ = [
   120→    "count_lines",
   121→    "matches_exclusion",
   122→    "normalize_path_separators",
   123→    "rel",
   124→    "resolve_path",
   125→    "resolve_scan_file",
   126→    "safe_relpath",
   127→    "safe_write_text",
   128→]
   129→

   197→def generate_plan_md(state: PlanState, plan: dict | None = None) -> str:
   198→    """Generate a prioritized markdown plan from state.
   199→
   200→    When *plan* is provided (or auto-loaded from disk), user-ordered
   201→    items, clusters, skipped, and superseded sections are rendered.
   202→    When no plan exists, output is identical to the previous behavior.
   203→    """
   204→    issues = state["issues"]
   205→    stats = state.get("stats", {})
   206→
   207→    # Auto-load plan if not provided
   208→    if plan is None:
   209→        try:
   210→            from desloppify.engine.plan import load_plan
   211→            plan = load_plan()
   212→        except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   213→            plan = {}
   214→    if not isinstance(plan, dict):
   215→        plan = {}
   216→    plan.setdefault("queue_order", [])
   217→    plan.setdefault("skipped", {})
   218→    plan.setdefault("clusters", {})
   219→
   220→    has_plan = bool(
   221→        plan
   222→        and (
   223→            plan.get("queue_order")
   224→            or plan.get("skipped")
   225→            or plan.get("clusters")
   226→        )
   227→    )
   228→
   229→    lines = _plan_header(state, stats)
   230→    lines.extend(_plan_dimension_table(state))
   231→    lines.extend(_summary_lines(stats))
   232→
   233→    if has_plan:
   234→        # Build full queue for item lookup
   235→        queue = build_work_queue(
   236→            state,
   237→            options=QueueBuildOptions(
   238→                count=None,
   239→                status="open",
   240→                include_subjective=True,
   241→            ),
   242→        )
   243→        all_items = queue.get("items", [])
   244→        lines.extend(_plan_user_ordered_section(all_items, plan))
   245→
   246→        # Remaining: items NOT in queue_order or skipped
   247→        ordered_ids = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   248→        skipped_ids = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   249→        plan_ids = ordered_ids | skipped_ids
   250→        remaining = [item for item in all_items if item.get("id") not in plan_ids]
   251→        if remaining:
   252→            lines.append("---")
   253→            lines.append(f"## Remaining (mechanical order, {len(remaining)} items)")
   254→            lines.append("")
   255→
   256→        lines.extend(_plan_item_sections(issues, state=state))
   257→        lines.extend(_plan_skipped_section(all_items, plan))
   258→        lines.extend(_plan_superseded_section(plan))
   259→    else:
   260→        lines.extend(_plan_item_sections(issues, state=state))
   261→
   262→    lines.extend(_addressed_section(issues))
   263→
   264→    return "\n".join(lines)
   265→

    61→    return path if path is not None else PLAN_FILE
    62→
    63→
    64→def _plan_file_for_state(state_file: Path | None) -> Path | None:
    65→    if state_file is None:
    66→        return None
    67→    return plan_path_for_state(state_file)
    68→
    69→
    70→def _snapshot_file(path: Path) -> str | None:
    71→    if not path.exists():
    72→        return None
    73→    return path.read_text()
    74→
    75→
    76→def _restore_file_snapshot(path: Path, snapshot: str | None) -> None:
    77→    if snapshot is None:
    78→        try:
    79→            path.unlink()
    80→        except FileNotFoundError:
    81→            return
    82→        return
    83→    safe_write_text(path, snapshot)
    84→
    85→
    86→def _save_plan_state_transactional(
    87→    *,
    88→    plan: dict,
    89→    plan_path: Path | None,
    90→    state_data: dict,
    91→    state_path_value: Path | None,
    92→) -> None:
    93→    """Persist plan+state together; rollback both files on partial write failure."""
    94→    effective_plan_path = _resolve_plan_file(plan_path)
    95→    effective_state_path = _resolve_state_file(state_path_value)
    96→    plan_snapshot = _snapshot_file(effective_plan_path)
    97→    state_snapshot = _snapshot_file(effective_state_path)
    98→
    99→    try:
   100→        state_mod.save_state(state_data, effective_state_path)
   101→        save_plan(plan, effective_plan_path)
   102→    except Exception:
   103→        _restore_file_snapshot(effective_state_path, state_snapshot)
   104→        _restore_file_snapshot(effective_plan_path, plan_snapshot)
   105→        raise
   106→

   163→def _validate_skip_requirements(
   164→    *,
   165→    kind: str,
   166→    attestation: str | None,
   167→    note: str | None,
   168→) -> bool:
   169→    if not skip_kind_requires_attestation(kind):
   170→        return True
   171→    if not validate_attestation(attestation):
   172→        show_attestation_requirement(
   173→            "Permanent skip" if kind == "permanent" else "False positive",
   174→            attestation,
   175→            ATTEST_EXAMPLE,
   176→        )
   177→        return False
   178→    if skip_kind_requires_note(kind) and not note:
   179→        print(
   180→            colorize("  --permanent requires --note to explain the decision.", "yellow"),
   181→            file=sys.stderr,
   182→        )
   183→        return False
   184→    return True

   187→def _apply_state_skip_resolution(
   188→    *,
   189→    kind: str,
   190→    state_file: Path | None,
   191→    issue_ids: list[str],
   192→    note: str | None,
   193→    attestation: str | None,
   194→) -> dict | None:
   195→    status = skip_kind_state_status(kind)
   196→    if status is None:
   197→        return None
   198→    state_data = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   199→    for fid in issue_ids:
   200→        state_mod.resolve_issues(
   201→            state_data,
   202→            fid,
   203→            status,
   204→            note or "",
   205→            attestation=attestation,
   206→        )
   207→    return state_data

   210→def cmd_plan_skip(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   211→    """Skip issues — unified command for temporary/permanent/false-positive."""
   212→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   213→    state = runtime.state
   214→    if not require_completed_scan(state):
   215→        return
   216→
   217→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   218→    reason: str | None = getattr(args, "reason", None)
   219→    review_after: int | None = getattr(args, "review_after", None)
   220→    permanent: bool = getattr(args, "permanent", False)
   221→    false_positive: bool = getattr(args, "false_positive", False)
   222→    note: str | None = getattr(args, "note", None)
   223→    attestation: str | None = getattr(args, "attest", None)
   224→
   225→    kind = skip_kind_from_flags(permanent=permanent, false_positive=false_positive)
   226→    if not _validate_skip_requirements(
   227→        kind=kind,
   228→        attestation=attestation,
   229→        note=note,
   230→    ):
   231→        return
   232→
   233→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   234→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)
   235→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
   236→    issue_ids = resolve_ids_from_patterns(state, patterns, plan=plan)
   237→    if not issue_ids:
   238→        print(colorize("  No matching issues found.", "yellow"))
   239→        return
   240→
   241→    # For permanent/false_positive: delegate to state layer for score impact
   242→    state_data = _apply_state_skip_resolution(
   243→        kind=kind,
   244→        state_file=state_file,
   245→        issue_ids=issue_ids,
   246→        note=note,
   247→        attestation=attestation,
   248→    )
   249→
   250→    scan_count = state.get("scan_count", 0)
   251→    count = skip_items(
   252→        plan,
   253→        issue_ids,
   254→        kind=kind,
   255→        reason=reason,
   256→        note=note,
   257→        attestation=attestation,
   258→        review_after=review_after,
   259→        scan_count=scan_count,
   260→    )
   261→
   262→    # Log the skip action
   263→    append_log_entry(
   264→        plan,
   265→        "skip",
   266→        issue_ids=issue_ids,
   267→        actor="user",
   268→        note=note,
   269→        detail={"kind": kind, "reason": reason},
   270→    )
   271→    if state_data is not None:
   272→        _save_plan_state_transactional(
   273→            plan=plan,
   274→            plan_path=plan_file,
   275→            state_data=state_data,
   276→            state_path_value=state_file,
   277→        )
   278→    else:
   279→        save_plan(plan, plan_file)
   280→
   281→    print(colorize(f"  {SKIP_KIND_LABELS[kind]} {count} item(s).", "green"))
   282→    if review_after:
   283→        print(colorize(f"  Will re-surface after {review_after} scan(s).", "dim"))
   284→    print_user_message(
   285→        "Hey — if skipping was the right call, just continue with"
   286→        " what you were doing. If you think a broader re-triage is"
   287→        " needed, use `desloppify plan triage`. Run `desloppify"
   288→        " plan --help` to see all available plan tools. Otherwise"
   289→        " no need to reply, just keep going."
   290→    )
   291→

   293→def cmd_plan_unskip(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   294→    """Unskip issues — bring back to queue."""
   295→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   296→    state = runtime.state
   297→    if not require_completed_scan(state):
   298→        return
   299→
   300→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   301→
   302→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   303→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)
   304→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
   305→    # For unskip we need to match against all statuses (skipped items may be wontfix/fp)
   306→    issue_ids = resolve_ids_from_patterns(state, patterns, plan=plan, status_filter="all")
   307→    if not issue_ids:
   308→        print(colorize("  No matching issues found.", "yellow"))
   309→        return
   310→
   311→    count, need_reopen = unskip_items(plan, issue_ids)
   312→    append_log_entry(
   313→        plan, "unskip", issue_ids=issue_ids, actor="user",
   314→        detail={"need_reopen": need_reopen},
   315→    )
   316→
   317→    # Reopen permanent/false_positive items in state
   318→    reopened: list[str] = []
   319→    if need_reopen:
   320→        state_data = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   321→        for fid in need_reopen:
   322→            reopened.extend(state_mod.resolve_issues(state_data, fid, "open"))
   323→        _save_plan_state_transactional(
   324→            plan=plan,
   325→            plan_path=plan_file,
   326→            state_data=state_data,
   327→            state_path_value=state_file,
   328→        )
   329→        print(colorize(f"  Reopened {len(reopened)} issue(s) in state.", "dim"))
   330→    else:
   331→        save_plan(plan, plan_file)
   332→
   333→    print(colorize(f"  Unskipped {count} item(s) — back in queue.", "green"))

   340→def cmd_plan_reopen(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   341→    """Reopen resolved issues from plan context."""
   342→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   343→
   344→    raw_state_path = state_path(args)
   345→    state_file = raw_state_path if isinstance(raw_state_path, Path) else Path(raw_state_path) if raw_state_path else None
   346→    state_data = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   347→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)
   348→
   349→    reopened: list[str] = []
   350→    for pattern in patterns:
   351→        reopened.extend(
   352→            state_mod.resolve_issues(state_data, pattern, "open")
   353→        )
   354→
   355→    if not reopened:
   356→        print(colorize("  No resolved issues matching: " + " ".join(patterns), "yellow"))
   357→        return
   358→
   359→    # Remove from skipped if present, and ensure all reopened IDs are in queue
   360→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
   361→
   362→    # Remove from commit tracking uncommitted list
   363→    purge_uncommitted_ids(plan, reopened)
   364→
   365→    skipped = plan.get("skipped", {})
   366→    count = 0
   367→    order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   368→    for fid in reopened:
   369→        if fid in skipped:
   370→            skipped.pop(fid)
   371→            count += 1
   372→        if fid not in order:
   373→            plan["queue_order"].append(fid)
   374→            order.add(fid)
   375→            count += 1
   376→    append_log_entry(
   377→        plan, "reopen", issue_ids=reopened, actor="user",
   378→    )
   379→    _save_plan_state_transactional(
   380→        plan=plan,
   381→        plan_path=plan_file,
   382→        state_data=state_data,
   383→        state_path_value=state_file,
   384→    )
   385→
   386→    print(colorize(f"  Reopened {len(reopened)} issue(s).", "green"))
   387→    if count:
   388→        print(colorize("  Plan updated: items moved back to queue.", "dim"))

   391→_CLUSTER_INDIVIDUAL_THRESHOLD = 10
   392→
   393→
   394→def _check_cluster_guard(patterns: list[str], plan: dict, state: dict) -> bool:
   395→    """Return True if blocked by cluster guard, False if OK to proceed."""
   396→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   397→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   398→    for pattern in patterns:
   399→        if pattern in clusters:
   400→            cluster = clusters[pattern]
   401→            # Filter to alive issues only — stale IDs should not count
   402→            ids = [
   403→                fid for fid in cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   404→                if fid in issues and issues[fid].get("status") == "open"
   405→            ]
   406→            if len(ids) == 0:
   407→                print(colorize(
   408→                    f"\n  Cluster '{pattern}' is empty — add items before marking it done.\n",
   409→                    "yellow",
   410→                ))
   411→                print(colorize(
   412→                    f"  Use: desloppify plan cluster add {pattern} <issue-id>",
   413→                    "dim",
   414→                ))
   415→                return True  # blocked
   416→            if len(ids) <= _CLUSTER_INDIVIDUAL_THRESHOLD:
   417→                _print_cluster_guard(pattern, ids, state)
   418→                return True  # blocked
   419→    return False  # OK
   420→
   421→
   422→def _print_cluster_guard(cluster_name: str, issue_ids: list[str], state: dict) -> None:
   423→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   424→    print(colorize(
   425→        f"\n  Cluster '{cluster_name}' has {len(issue_ids)} item(s) — mark them done individually first:\n",
   426→        "yellow",
   427→    ))
   428→    for fid in issue_ids:
   429→        f = issues.get(fid, {})
   430→        summary = f.get("summary", "(no summary)")[:80]
   431→        detector = f.get("detector", "?")
   432→        print(f"    {fid}  [{detector}]  {summary}")
   433→    print(colorize(
   434→        "\n  Use: desloppify resolve <id> --status fixed --note '...' --attest '...'",
   435→        "dim",
   436→    ))
   437→    print(colorize(
   438→        "  Or mark each resolved: desloppify plan resolve <id> --note '...' --confirm\n",
   439→        "dim",
   440→    ))
   441→
   442→
   443→def _is_synthetic_id(fid: str) -> bool:
   444→    """Return True if the ID is a synthetic workflow/triage item, not a real issue."""
   445→    return fid.startswith("triage::") or fid.startswith("workflow::") or fid.startswith("subjective::")
   446→
   447→
   448→def _resolve_synthetic_ids(patterns: list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
   449→    """Separate synthetic IDs from real issue patterns.
   450→
   451→    Returns (synthetic_ids, remaining_patterns).
   452→    """
   453→    synthetic = [p for p in patterns if _is_synthetic_id(p)]
   454→    remaining = [p for p in patterns if not _is_synthetic_id(p)]
   455→    return synthetic, remaining
   456→
   457→
   458→def _blocked_triage_stages(plan: dict) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
   459→    """Return ``{stage_id: [blocked_by_ids]}`` for triage stages that can't run yet.
   460→
   461→    Uses the dependency graph and confirmed-stage metadata directly —
   462→    no state needed, no queue item construction.
   463→    """
   464→    order_set = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   465→    present = order_set & TRIAGE_IDS
   466→    if not present:
   467→        return {}
   468→
   469→    confirmed = set(plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {}).get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   470→    stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   471→
   472→    blocked: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   473→    for sid, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names, strict=False):
   474→        if sid not in present or name in confirmed:
   475→            continue
   476→        deps = TRIAGE_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES.get(name, set())
   477→        unmet = sorted(
   478→            f"triage::{dep}" for dep in deps
   479→            if f"triage::{dep}" in present and dep not in confirmed
   480→        )
   481→        if unmet:
   482→            blocked[sid] = unmet
   483→    return blocked
   484→
   485→
   486→def cmd_plan_resolve(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   487→    """Mark issues as fixed — delegates to cmd_resolve for rich UX."""
   488→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   489→    attestation: str | None = getattr(args, "attest", None)
   490→    note: str | None = getattr(args, "note", None)
   491→
   492→    # --confirm: auto-generate attestation from --note
   493→    if getattr(args, "confirm", False):
   494→        if not note:
   495→            print(colorize("  --confirm requires --note to describe what you did.", "red"))
   496→            return
   497→        attestation = f"I have actually {note} and I am not gaming the score."
   498→        args.attest = attestation
   499→
   500→    # Handle synthetic IDs (triage::*, workflow::*, subjective::*) directly
   501→    synthetic_ids, real_patterns = _resolve_synthetic_ids(patterns)
   502→    if synthetic_ids:
   503→        plan = load_plan()
   504→        # Validate triage dependency chain
   505→        blocked_map = _blocked_triage_stages(plan)
   506→        for sid in synthetic_ids:
   507→            if sid in blocked_map:
   508→                deps = ", ".join(b.replace("triage::", "") for b in blocked_map[sid])
   509→                print(colorize(f"  Cannot resolve {sid} — blocked by: {deps}", "red"))
   510→                print(colorize("  Complete those stages first, or use --force-resolve to override.", "dim"))
   511→                if not getattr(args, "force_resolve", False):
   512→                    return
   513→        purge_ids(plan, synthetic_ids)
   514→        append_log_entry(
   515→            plan, "done", issue_ids=synthetic_ids, actor="user", note=note,
   516→        )
   517→        save_plan(plan)
   518→        for sid in synthetic_ids:
   519→            print(colorize(f"  Resolved: {sid}", "green"))
   520→        if not real_patterns:
   521→            return
   522→        # Continue with remaining real patterns
   523→        patterns = real_patterns
   524→        args.patterns = patterns
   525→
   526→    # Validate note length
   527→    if not validate_note_length(note):
   528→        show_note_length_requirement(note)
   529→        return
   530→
   531→    # Pre-validate attestation before delegating (avoids stale hint in resolve)
   532→    if not validate_attestation(attestation):
   533→        show_attestation_requirement("Plan resolve", attestation, ATTEST_EXAMPLE)
   534→        return
   535→
   536→    # Cluster completion guard: block bulk-completing small clusters
   537→    try:
   538→        runtime = command_runtime(args)
   539→        state = runtime.state
   540→        plan = load_plan()
   541→        if _check_cluster_guard(patterns, plan, state):
   542→            return
   543→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   544→        plan = None
   545→
   546→    # Log the done action (best-effort)
   547→    try:
   548→        if plan is None:
   549→            plan = load_plan()
   550→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   551→        cluster_name = None
   552→        for p in patterns:
   553→            if p in clusters:
   554→                cluster_name = p
   555→                break
   556→        append_log_entry(
   557→            plan,
   558→            "done",
   559→            issue_ids=patterns,
   560→            cluster_name=cluster_name,
   561→            actor="user",
   562→            note=note,
   563→        )
   564→        save_plan(plan)
   565→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   566→        log_best_effort_failure(logger, "append plan resolve log entry", exc)
   567→        print(colorize(f"  Note: unable to append plan resolve log entry ({exc}).", "dim"))
   568→
   569→    # Build a Namespace that cmd_resolve expects
   570→    resolve_args = argparse.Namespace(
   571→        status="fixed",
   572→        patterns=patterns,
   573→        note=note,
   574→        attest=attestation,
   575→        confirm_batch_wontfix=False,
   576→        force_resolve=bool(getattr(args, "force_resolve", False)),
   577→        state=getattr(args, "state", None),
   578→        lang=getattr(args, "lang", None),
   579→        path=getattr(args, "path", None),
   580→        exclude=getattr(args, "exclude", None),
   581→    )
   582→
   583→    cmd_resolve(resolve_args)
   584→
   585→

   131→    """Return a banner string when triage stage IDs are in the queue."""
   132→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   133→    order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   134→    has_triage = any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS)
   135→    if not has_triage:
   136→        return ""
   137→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   138→    stages = meta.get("triage_stages", {})
   139→    completed = [s for s in ("observe", "reflect", "organize") if s in stages]
   140→    if completed:
   141→        return (
   142→            f"TRIAGE MODE ({len(completed)}/4 stages complete) — "
   143→            "complete all stages to exit. Run: desloppify plan triage"
   144→        )
   145→    return (
   146→        "TRIAGE MODE — review issues need analysis before fixing. "
   147→        "Run: desloppify plan triage"
   148→    )

1→"""Plan persistence — load/save with atomic writes."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import json
     6→import logging
     7→import shutil
     8→import sys
     9→from pathlib import Path
    10→
    11→from desloppify.base.discovery.file_paths import safe_write_text
    12→from desloppify.base.output.fallbacks import log_best_effort_failure
    13→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import (
    14→    PLAN_VERSION,
    15→    PlanModel,
    16→    empty_plan,
    17→    ensure_plan_defaults,
    18→    validate_plan,
    19→)
    20→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import STATE_DIR, json_default, utc_now
    21→
    22→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    23→
    24→PLAN_FILE = STATE_DIR / "plan.json"
    25→
    26→
    27→def load_plan(path: Path | None = None) -> PlanModel:
    28→    """Load plan from disk, or return empty plan on missing/corruption."""
    29→    plan_path = path or PLAN_FILE
    30→    if not plan_path.exists():
    31→        return empty_plan()
    32→
    33→    try:
    34→        data = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
    35→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError, OSError) as ex:
    36→        # Try backup before giving up
    37→        backup = plan_path.with_suffix(".json.bak")
    38→        if backup.exists():
    39→            try:
    40→                data = json.loads(backup.read_text())
    41→                logger.warning("Plan file corrupted (%s), loaded from backup.", ex)
    42→                print(f"  Warning: Plan file corrupted ({ex}), loaded from backup.", file=sys.stderr)
    43→                # Fall through to validation below
    44→            except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError, OSError) as backup_ex:
    45→                logger.warning("Plan file and backup both corrupted: %s / %s", ex, backup_ex)
    46→                print(f"  Warning: Plan file corrupted ({ex}). Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    47→                return empty_plan()
    48→        else:
    49→            logger.warning("Plan file corrupted (%s). Starting fresh.", ex)
    50→            print(f"  Warning: Plan file corrupted ({ex}). Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    51→            return empty_plan()
    52→
    53→    if not isinstance(data, dict):
    54→        logger.warning("Plan file root is not a JSON object. Starting fresh.")
    55→        print("  Warning: Plan file root must be a JSON object. Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    56→        return empty_plan()
    57→
    58→    version = data.get("version", 1)
    59→    if version > PLAN_VERSION:
    60→        logger.warning("Plan file version %d > supported %d.", version, PLAN_VERSION)
    61→        print(
    62→            f"  Warning: Plan file version {version} is newer than supported "
    63→            f"({PLAN_VERSION}). Some features may not work correctly.",
    64→            file=sys.stderr,
    65→        )
    66→
    67→    ensure_plan_defaults(data)
    68→    try:
    69→        validate_plan(data)
    70→    except ValueError as ex:
    71→        logger.warning("Plan invariants invalid (%s). Starting fresh.", ex)
    72→        print(f"  Warning: Plan invariants invalid ({ex}). Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    73→        return empty_plan()
    74→
    75→    return data  # type: ignore[return-value]
    76→
    77→
    78→def save_plan(plan: PlanModel | dict, path: Path | None = None) -> None:
    79→    """Validate and save plan to disk atomically."""
    80→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
    81→    plan["updated"] = utc_now()
    82→    validate_plan(plan)
    83→
    84→    plan_path = path or PLAN_FILE
    85→    plan_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    86→
    87→    content = json.dumps(plan, indent=2, default=json_default) + "\n"
    88→
    89→    if plan_path.exists():
    90→        backup = plan_path.with_suffix(".json.bak")
    91→        try:
    92→            shutil.copy2(str(plan_path), str(backup))
    93→        except OSError as backup_ex:
    94→            log_best_effort_failure(logger, "create plan backup", backup_ex)
    95→
    96→    try:
    97→        safe_write_text(plan_path, content)
    98→    except OSError as ex:
    99→        print(f"  Warning: Could not save plan: {ex}", file=sys.stderr)
   100→        raise
   101→
   102→
   103→def plan_path_for_state(state_path: Path) -> Path:
   104→    """Derive plan.json path from a state file path."""
   105→    return state_path.parent / "plan.json"
   106→
   107→
   108→def has_living_plan(path: Path | None = None) -> bool:
   109→    """Return True if a plan.json exists and has user intent."""
   110→    plan_path = path or PLAN_FILE
   111→    if not plan_path.exists():
   112→        return False
   113→    plan = load_plan(plan_path)
   114→    return bool(
   115→        plan.get("queue_order")
   116→        or plan.get("overrides")
   117→        or plan.get("clusters")
   118→    )
   119→
   120→
   121→__all__ = [
   122→    "PLAN_FILE",
   123→    "has_living_plan",
   124→    "load_plan",
   125→    "plan_path_for_state",
   126→    "save_plan",
   127→]
   128→

1→"""Skip/unskip mutations for plan operations."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.engine._plan.operations_queue import _remove_id_from_lists
     6→from desloppify.engine._plan.promoted_ids import prune_promoted_ids
     7→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import PlanModel, SkipEntry, ensure_plan_defaults
     8→from desloppify.engine._plan.skip_policy import skip_kind_needs_state_reopen
     9→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import utc_now
    10→
    11→
    12→def skip_items(
    13→    plan: PlanModel,
    14→    issue_ids: list[str],
    15→    *,
    16→    kind: str = "temporary",
    17→    reason: str | None = None,
    18→    note: str | None = None,
    19→    attestation: str | None = None,
    20→    review_after: int | None = None,
    21→    scan_count: int = 0,
    22→) -> int:
    23→    """Move issue IDs to the skipped dict. Returns count skipped."""
    24→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
    25→    now = utc_now()
    26→    count = 0
    27→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan["skipped"]
    28→    skip_set = set(issue_ids)
    29→    prune_promoted_ids(plan, skip_set)
    30→    for fid in issue_ids:
    31→        _remove_id_from_lists(plan, fid)
    32→        skipped[fid] = {
    33→            "issue_id": fid,
    34→            "kind": kind,
    35→            "reason": reason,
    36→            "note": note,
    37→            "attestation": attestation,
    38→            "created_at": now,
    39→            "review_after": review_after,
    40→            "skipped_at_scan": scan_count,
    41→        }
    42→        count += 1
    43→    return count
    44→
    45→
    46→def unskip_items(
    47→    plan: PlanModel, issue_ids: list[str]
    48→) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    49→    """Bring issue IDs back from skipped to the end of queue_order.
    50→
    51→    Returns ``(count_unskipped, permanent_ids_needing_state_reopen)``
    52→    where the second list contains IDs that were permanent or false_positive
    53→    and need their state-layer status reopened by the caller.
    54→    """
    55→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
    56→    count = 0
    57→    need_reopen: list[str] = []
    58→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan["skipped"]
    59→    for fid in issue_ids:
    60→        entry = skipped.pop(fid, None)
    61→        if entry is not None:
    62→            if skip_kind_needs_state_reopen(str(entry.get("kind", ""))):
    63→                need_reopen.append(fid)
    64→            if fid not in plan["queue_order"]:
    65→                plan["queue_order"].append(fid)
    66→            count += 1
    67→    return count, need_reopen
    68→
    69→
    70→def resurface_stale_skips(
    71→    plan: PlanModel, current_scan_count: int
    72→) -> list[str]:
    73→    """Move temporary skips past their review_after threshold back to queue.
    74→
    75→    Returns list of resurfaced issue IDs.
    76→    """
    77→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
    78→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan["skipped"]
    79→    resurfaced: list[str] = []
    80→    for fid in list(skipped):
    81→        entry = skipped[fid]
    82→        if entry.get("kind") != "temporary":
    83→            continue
    84→        review_after = entry.get("review_after")
    85→        if review_after is None:
    86→            continue
    87→        skipped_at = entry.get("skipped_at_scan", 0)
    88→        if current_scan_count >= skipped_at + review_after:
    89→            skipped.pop(fid)
    90→            if fid not in plan["queue_order"]:
    91→                plan["queue_order"].append(fid)
    92→            resurfaced.append(fid)
    93→    return resurfaced
    94→
    95→
    96→__all__ = ["resurface_stale_skips", "skip_items", "unskip_items"]
    97→

   166→def empty_plan() -> PlanModel:
   167→    """Return a new empty plan payload."""
   168→    now = utc_now()
   169→    return {
   170→        "version": PLAN_VERSION,
   171→        "created": now,
   172→        "updated": now,
   173→        "queue_order": [],
   174→        "deferred": [],
   175→        "skipped": {},
   176→        "active_cluster": None,
   177→        "overrides": {},
   178→        "clusters": {},
   179→        "superseded": {},
   180→        "promoted_ids": [],
   181→        "plan_start_scores": {},
   182→        "execution_log": [],
   183→        "epic_triage_meta": {},
   184→        "commit_log": [],
   185→        "uncommitted_issues": [],
   186→        "commit_tracking_branch": None,
   187→    }
   188→
   189→
   190→def ensure_plan_defaults(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   191→    """Normalize a loaded plan to ensure all keys exist.
   192→
   193→    Runtime contract is v7-only. Legacy payloads are upgraded in-place once.
   194→    """
   195→    defaults = empty_plan()
   196→    for key, value in defaults.items():
   197→        plan.setdefault(key, value)
   198→    _upgrade_plan_to_v7(plan)
   199→
   200→
   201→def triage_clusters(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Cluster]:
   202→    """Return clusters whose name starts with ``EPIC_PREFIX``."""
   203→    return {
   204→        name: cluster
   205→        for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items()
   206→        if name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX)
   207→    }
   208→
   209→
   210→def validate_plan(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   211→    """Raise ValueError when plan invariants are violated."""
   212→    if not isinstance(plan.get("version"), int):
   213→        raise ValueError("plan.version must be an int")
   214→    if not isinstance(plan.get("queue_order"), list):
   215→        raise ValueError("plan.queue_order must be a list")
   216→
   217→    # No ID should appear in both queue_order and skipped
   218→    skipped_ids = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   219→    overlap = set(plan["queue_order"]) & skipped_ids
   220→    if overlap:
   221→        raise ValueError(
   222→            f"IDs cannot appear in both queue_order and skipped: {sorted(overlap)}"
   223→        )
   224→
   225→    # Validate skip entry kinds
   226→    for fid, entry in plan.get("skipped", {}).items():
   227→        kind = entry.get("kind")
   228→        if kind not in VALID_SKIP_KINDS:
   229→            raise ValueError(
   230→                f"Invalid skip kind {kind!r} for {fid}; must be one of {sorted(VALID_SKIP_KINDS)}"
   231→            )
   232→
   233→
   234→__all__ = [
   235→    "EPIC_PREFIX",
   236→    "EpicTriageMeta",
   237→    "ExecutionLogEntry",
   238→    "PLAN_VERSION",
   239→    "Cluster",
   240→    "CommitRecord",
   241→    "ItemOverride",
   242→    "LastTriageSnapshot",

   250→    "empty_plan",
   251→    "ensure_plan_defaults",
   252→    "triage_clusters",
   253→    "validate_plan",
   254→]
   255→
